                    c.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p.life));
                    c.fillStyle = p.color;
                    c.translate(p.x, p.y);
                    c.rotate(p.angle);
                    c.beginPath();
                    c.moveTo(0, -p.size);
                    c.lineTo(p.size, 0);
                    c.lineTo(0, p.size);
                    c.lineTo(-p.size, 0);
                    c.closePath();
                    c.fill();
                    c.restore();
                }
                if (alive) {
                    rewardParticleAnim = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
                } else {
                    c.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
                    rewardParticleAnim = null;
                }
            }
            rewardParticleAnim = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }

        function showCarRewardScreen(id) {
            rewardCarId = id;
            state = 'carreward';
            track('car-offer-' + abRewardGroup, level, 'visible');
            renderRewardCar(id);
            const pc = rewardParticlesCanvas.getContext('2d');
            pc.clearRect(0, 0, rewardParticlesCanvas.width, rewardParticlesCanvas.height);

            if (abRewardGroup === 'B') {
                rewardGetBtn.innerHTML = `<span>${getTranslation('free')}</span>${adBadgeSVG}`;
                const cfg = getCarConfig(id);
                if (cfg.price) {
                    rewardPriceTagInner.textContent = formatPrice(cfg.price);
                    rewardPriceTag.style.display = 'block';
                    rewardPriceTag.style.opacity = '1';
                } else {
                    rewardPriceTag.style.display = 'none';
                }
            } else {
                rewardGetBtn.innerHTML = `<span>${getTranslation('get')}</span>${adBadgeSVG}`;
                rewardPriceTag.style.display = 'none';
            }

            rewardLoseBtn.innerHTML = `<span>${getTranslation('lose')}</span>`;
            rewardGetBtn.style.display = '';
            rewardLoseBtn.style.display = '';
            carRewardOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
            rewardOverlayVisible = true;
            fitRewardButtons();
            updateSkinUI();
        }

        // Shrinks the GET and LOSE labels together until both fit their buttons
        // (only needed for languages with long words).
        function fitRewardButtons() {
            const btns = [rewardGetBtn, rewardLoseBtn];
            // Label + icon wider than the space inside the padding?
            const overflows = (b) => {
                const cs = getComputedStyle(b);
                let content = (parseFloat(cs.columnGap) || 0) * Math.max(0, b.children.length - 1);
                for (const ch of b.children) content += ch.getBoundingClientRect().width;
                return content > b.clientWidth - parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft) - parseFloat(cs.paddingRight) + 0.5;
            };
            btns.forEach(b => b.style.fontSize = '');
            let size = 20;
            while (size > 12 && btns.some(overflows)) {
                size--;
                btns.forEach(b => b.style.fontSize = size + 'px');
            }
        }

        function hideCarRewardScreen() {
            carRewardOverlay.style.display = 'none';
            rewardOverlayVisible = false;
        }

        function resolveReward(unlocked) {
            const id = rewardCarId;
            if (id < 0) return;

            track('car-offer-' + abRewardGroup, level, unlocked ? 'received' : 'skipped');

            if (unlocked) {
                if (!carDesigns.unlocked.includes(id)) carDesigns.unlocked.push(id);
                carDesigns.offered = carDesigns.offered.filter(x => x !== id);
                setSelectedCar(id);
                renderSkinTiles();

                renderRewardCarGreen(id);
                playRewardParticles();
                rewardGetBtn.style.display = 'none';
                rewardLoseBtn.style.display = 'none';
                if (rewardPriceTag.style.display !== 'none') {
                    rewardPriceTag.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => { rewardPriceTag.style.display = 'none'; }, 400);
                }
                playSound('end', -5, cx, cy, 0.51);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (rewardParticleAnim) { cancelAnimationFrame(rewardParticleAnim); rewardParticleAnim = null; }
                    rewardGetBtn.style.display = '';
                    rewardLoseBtn.style.display = '';
                    rewardCarId = -1;
                    hideCarRewardScreen();
                    setupLevel(level + 1, true, true);
                    doZoomFlourish();
                }, 1010);
            } else {
                if (!carDesigns.offered.includes(id)) carDesigns.offered.push(id);
                saveCarDesigns();
                renderSkinTiles();
                rewardCarId = -1;
                hideCarRewardScreen();
                setupLevel(level + 1, true, true);
            }
        }

        function onRewardGet() {
            if (isAdPlaying) return;
            // GET/FREE-button car unlock uses a SMALL rewarded ad.
            track('car-offer-' + abRewardGroup, level, 'reward');
            playRewardedAd((success) => {
                resolveReward(success);
            }, 'small');
        }

        function onRewardLose() {
            track('car-offer-' + abRewardGroup, level, 'skip');
            resolveReward(false);
        }

        function proceedToNextLevel() {
            const pending = getPendingUnlockCar(level);
            if (pending !== null) {
                showCarRewardScreen(pending);
            } else {
                setupLevel(level + 1, true, true);
            }
        }

        let gameplayActive = false;
        function pokiGameplayStart() {
            if (gameplayActive) return;
            gameplayActive = true;
            track('level', level, 'start');
            if (typeof PokiSDK !== 'undefined') PokiSDK.gameplayStart();
        }
        function pokiGameplayStop() {
            if (!gameplayActive) return;
            gameplayActive = false;
            if (typeof PokiSDK !== 'undefined') PokiSDK.gameplayStop();
        }
        
        function triggerCommercialBreak(callback) {
            if (typeof PokiSDK !== 'undefined') {
                isAdPlaying = true;
                if (audioCtx.state === 'running') audioCtx.suspend();
                let settled = false;
                const finish = () => {
                    if (settled) return;
                    settled = true;
                    clearTimeout(watchdog);
                    isAdPlaying = false;
                    if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                    callback();
                };
                let watchdog = setTimeout(finish, 6000);
                PokiSDK.commercialBreak(() => {
                    clearTimeout(watchdog);
                }).then(finish).catch(finish);
            } else {
                callback();
            }
        }

        function saveLevel(lvl) {
            try { localStorage.setItem('neonOvalDashLevel', lvl); } catch (e) {}
            try { document.cookie = `neonOvalDashLevel=${lvl}; max-age=31536000; path=/`; } catch (e) {}
        }

        function hasSavedLevel() {
            let lvl = null;
            try { lvl = localStorage.getItem('neonOvalDashLevel'); } catch (e) {}
            if (!lvl) {
                try {
                    const match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )neonOvalDashLevel=([^;]*)/);
                    if (match) lvl = match[1];
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            return !!lvl;
        }

        function loadLevel() {
            let lvl = null;
            try { lvl = localStorage.getItem('neonOvalDashLevel'); } catch (e) {}
            if (!lvl) {
                try {
                    const match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )neonOvalDashLevel=([^;]*)/);
                    if (match) lvl = match[1];
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            return lvl ? parseInt(lvl, 10) : 1;
        }

        function updateScale() {
            if (!currentTrack) return;
            
            const dpr = getDpr();
            let logicalWidth = window.innerWidth;
            let logicalHeight = window.innerHeight;

            let trackW = currentTrack.extentX * 2 + trackWidth * 2 + 80; 
            let trackH = currentTrack.extentY * 2 + trackWidth * 2 + 250; 
            
            let scaleX = logicalWidth / trackW;
            let scaleY = logicalHeight / trackH;
            let baseScale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY, 1.3);
            if (!isFinite(baseScale) || baseScale <= 0) baseScale = 1;
            globalScale = baseScale * dpr; 
            
            gameWidth = logicalWidth / baseScale;
            gameHeight = logicalHeight / baseScale;
            if (!isFinite(gameWidth) || gameWidth <= 0) gameWidth = window.innerWidth || 1;
            if (!isFinite(gameHeight) || gameHeight <= 0) gameHeight = window.innerHeight || 1;
            
            cx = gameWidth / 2;
            cy = gameHeight / 2 - 20; 
        }

        function resize() {
            const dpr = getDpr();
            const w = Math.floor(window.innerWidth * dpr);
            const h = Math.floor(window.innerHeight * dpr);
            const prevScale = globalScale, prevW = gameWidth, prevH = gameHeight;
            // Resizing a canvas reallocates (and clears) it, and the cached track
            // layers would need redrawing, so only do it when something changed.
            const sizeChanged = canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h;
            if (sizeChanged) {
                canvas.width = w;
                canvas.height = h;
            }
            canvas.style.width = window.innerWidth + 'px';
            canvas.style.height = window.innerHeight + 'px';
            updateScale();
            // 'low' is plain bilinear filtering. Unlike 'medium'/'high' it never
            // makes the browser build mipmaps of a source canvas while drawing,
            // which can mean copying the whole source on every drawImage (a big
            // hidden cost with sprite sheets and full-screen layers). Nothing here
            // needs them: layers draw at ~1:1 or larger, the beam sprite is soft,
            // and the cars come with their own pre-shrunk copies.
            ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
            ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'low';
            if (sizeChanged || globalScale !== prevScale || gameWidth !== prevW || gameHeight !== prevH) {
                invalidateTrackLayers();
            }
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

        function evalTrackAt(def, d, out) {
            const segs = def.segs;
            let rem = d;
            for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
                const s = segs[i];
                if (rem <= s.len || i === segs.length - 1) {
                    const t = Math.min(rem, s.len);
                    if (s.type === 'line') {
                        out.x = cx + s.x0 + s.ux * t;
                        out.y = cy + s.y0 + s.uy * t;
                        out.angle = s.ang;
                        out.isCurve = false;
                        out.curveDir = 1;
                    } else {
                        const dir = s.a1 >= s.a0 ? 1 : -1;
                        const a = s.a0 + dir * (t / s.r);
                        out.x = cx + s.cx + s.r * Math.cos(a);
                        out.y = cy + s.cy + s.r * Math.sin(a);
                        out.angle = a + dir * Math.PI / 2;
                        out.isCurve = true;
                        out.curveDir = dir;
                    }
                    return;
                }
                rem -= s.len;
            }
        }

        function updateTrackPosition(car, distance) {
            let d = distance % currentTrack.perimeter;
            if (d < 0) d += currentTrack.perimeter;

            if (currentTrack.type !== 'rect') {
                evalTrackAt(currentTrack, d, car);
                return;
            }

            let { sx, sy, r } = currentTrack;
            let cL = Math.PI * r / 2;

            let br_cx = cx + sx/2; let br_cy = cy + sy/2;
            let tr_cx = cx + sx/2; let tr_cy = cy - sy/2;
            let tl_cx = cx - sx/2; let tl_cy = cy - sy/2;
            let bl_cx = cx - sx/2; let bl_cy = cy + sy/2;

            car.isCurve = false;
            car.curveDir = 1;

            if (d < sx/2) {
                car.x = cx - d; car.y = cy + sy/2 + r; car.angle = Math.PI;
            } else if (d < sx/2 + cL) {
                car.isCurve = true;
                let curveD = d - sx/2;
                let theta = Math.PI/2 + (curveD/cL)*(Math.PI/2);
                car.x = bl_cx + Math.cos(theta)*r; car.y = bl_cy + Math.sin(theta)*r; car.angle = theta + Math.PI/2;
            } else if (d < sx/2 + cL + sy) {
                let straightD = d - (sx/2 + cL);
                car.x = cx - sx/2 - r; car.y = cy + sy/2 - straightD; car.angle = -Math.PI/2;
            } else if (d < sx/2 + 2*cL + sy) {
                car.isCurve = true;
                let curveD = d - (sx/2 + cL + sy);
                let theta = Math.PI + (curveD/cL)*(Math.PI/2);
                car.x = tl_cx + Math.cos(theta)*r; car.y = tl_cy + Math.sin(theta)*r; car.angle = theta + Math.PI/2;
            } else if (d < 1.5*sx + 2*cL + sy) {
                let straightD = d - (sx/2 + 2*cL + sy);
                car.x = cx - sx/2 + straightD; car.y = cy - sy/2 - r; car.angle = 0;
            } else if (d < 1.5*sx + 3*cL + sy) {
                car.isCurve = true;
                let curveD = d - (1.5*sx + 2*cL + sy);
                let theta = Math.PI*1.5 + (curveD/cL)*(Math.PI/2);
                car.x = tr_cx + Math.cos(theta)*r; car.y = tr_cy + Math.sin(theta)*r; car.angle = theta + Math.PI/2;
            } else if (d < 1.5*sx + 3*cL + 2*sy) {
                let straightD = d - (1.5*sx + 3*cL + sy);
                car.x = cx + sx/2 + r; car.y = cy - sy/2 + straightD; car.angle = Math.PI/2;
            } else if (d < 1.5*sx + 4*cL + 2*sy) {
                car.isCurve = true;
                let curveD = d - (1.5*sx + 3*cL + 2*sy);
                let theta = 0 + (curveD/cL)*(Math.PI/2);
                car.x = br_cx + Math.cos(theta)*r; car.y = br_cy + Math.sin(theta)*r; car.angle = theta + Math.PI/2;
            } else {
                let straightD = d - (1.5*sx + 4*cL + 2*sy);
                car.x = cx + sx/2 - straightD; car.y = cy + sy/2 + r; car.angle = Math.PI;
            }
        }

        function computeLiftF(distance) {
            const ops = currentTrack.opInfos;
            if (!ops) return 0;
            let dd = distance % currentTrack.perimeter;
            if (dd < 0) dd += currentTrack.perimeter;
            for (let i = 0; i < ops.length; i++) {
                const t = (dd - ops[i].start) / ops[i].len;
                if (t > 0.10 && t < 0.90) return 1;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        function spawnParticle(x, y, color, speedScale = 1, angle = null, spread = null, type = 'collision') {
            let p = null;
            for (let n = 0; n < MAX_PARTICLES; n++) {
                const idx = (particleCursor + n) % MAX_PARTICLES;
                if (!particlePool[idx].active) {
                    p = particlePool[idx];
                    particleCursor = (idx + 1) % MAX_PARTICLES;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (p) {
                p.active = true;
                p.type = type;
                p.x = x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 5;
                p.y = y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 5;
                if (angle !== null && spread !== null) {
                    let a = angle + (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread;
                    let speed = Math.random() * 450 * speedScale;
                    p.vx = Math.cos(a) * speed;
                    p.vy = Math.sin(a) * speed;
                } else {
                    p.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 450 * speedScale;
                    p.vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 450 * speedScale;
                }
                p.life = 1.0;
                if (type === 'collision') {
                    p.decay = 0.04 + Math.random() * 0.04;
                    p.size = (1.0 + Math.random() * 1.5) * 1.8; 
                } else {
                    p.decay = 0.04 + Math.random() * 0.04;
                    p.size = 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5; 
                }
                p.color = color;
                p.angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                p.omega = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
            }
        }

        function addHistory(car) {
            if (!showTrails) {
                car.historyCount = 0;
                return;
            }
            if (!shouldEmitTrail) return;
            let h = car.history[car.historyIdx];
            h.x = car.x;
            h.y = car.y;
            h.angle = car.angle;
            h.driftAngle = car.driftAngle;
            h.lift = 0;
            car.historyIdx = (car.historyIdx + 1) % 12;
            if (car.historyCount < 12) car.historyCount++;
        }

        function createCarObj(stateStr, color) {
            return {
                id: carIdCounter++,
                state: stateStr,
                indexInQueue: 0,
                distance: 0,
                entryDist: 0,
                actualSpeed: trackSpeed,
                x: 0, y: 0, angle: 0, isCurve: false,
                curveDir: 1,
                liftF: 0,
                driftAngle: 0,
                steerAngle: 0,
                vx: 0, vy: 0, omega: 0,
                color: color,
                isPolice: color === policeColor || color === fireTruckColor,
                isFireTruck: color === fireTruckColor,
                policeActivated: false,
                flashTimer: 0,
                finishLightTimer: 0,
                mergeFxT: -1,   // seconds since it merged onto the track (-1: no effect)
                mergeFxStrong: false,   // the bigger, brighter version of that effect
                finishAnimTriggered: false,
                finishIndex: -1,
                finishAngle: 0,
                crashed: false,
                history: Array.from({length: 12}, () => ({x:0, y:0, angle:0, driftAngle:0, lift:0})),
                historyIdx: 0,
                historyCount: 0,
                historyTimer: 0,
                collisionGrace: 0,
                damage: Array.from({length: 10}, () => ({x:0, y:0}))
            };
        }

        function maintainQueue() {
            if (state === 'gameover' || isPreloaded) return;
            
            let queuedCount = 0;
            let enteringCount = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                if (cars[i].state === 'queue') queuedCount++;
                else if (cars[i].state === 'entering_straight' || cars[i].state === 'entering_curve') enteringCount++;
            }
            
            let needed = Math.min(5, targetCars - carsAdded - enteringCount) - queuedCount;
            const mergeY = cy + currentTrack.bottomOff;

            for (let i = 0; i < needed; i++) {
                let car = createCarObj('queue', activePaletteColors[(carsAdded + 3 + queuedCount + i) % activePaletteColors.length]);
                car.indexInQueue = queuedCount + i;
                car.x = cx + entryRadius;
                car.y = gameHeight + 100;
                car.targetY = 0;
                car.angle = -Math.PI/2;
                cars.push(car);
            }
            
            let qIdx = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                if (cars[i].state === 'queue') {
                    cars[i].targetY = mergeY + entryRadius + 15 + qIdx * 45;
                    qIdx++;
                }
            }
        }

        // Removes ONE car from the tail (highest indexInQueue) of the waiting
        // stack. Never removes a police car (or fire truck) — if the last car in
        // the queue is one, it simply stops (treats this as "succeeded") instead of
        // digging further into the stack to find a non-police car.
        function removeCarFromStack() {
            let maxIdx = -1, targetPos = -1, target = null;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                if (cars[i].state === 'queue' && cars[i].indexInQueue > maxIdx) {
                    maxIdx = cars[i].indexInQueue;
                    target = cars[i];
                    targetPos = i;
                }
            }
            if (!target) return;
            if (target.isPolice) return; // reached a police car — assume success, stop here
            cars.splice(targetPos, 1);
            if (target.color !== exitColor) {
                targetCars = Math.max(0, targetCars - 1);
            }
        }

        // Applies the two (independent, non-compounding) stack-shrinking
        // difficulty reductions:
        //   1) After 15 losses on this exact level, every future attempt on it
        //      removes exactly 1 car from the stack (not cumulative further).
        //   2) If this session's player is a "returning player" resuming this
        //      exact level, the stack is additionally reduced (every attempt of
        //      that level, this session) by floor(queueLength/10)+1 cars.
        function applyDifficultyReductions() {
            let baseQueueCount = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                if (cars[i].state === 'queue') baseQueueCount++;
            }
            let removals = 0;
            if ((levelLosses[level] || 0) >= 15) removals += 1;
            if (returningPlayerLevel !== null && level === returningPlayerLevel) {
                removals += Math.floor(baseQueueCount / 10) + 1;
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < removals; i++) removeCarFromStack();
        }

        function makeCrashed(car) {
            if (car.crashed) return;
            car.crashed = true;
            
            car.vx = Math.cos(car.angle) * car.actualSpeed;
            car.vy = Math.sin(car.angle) * car.actualSpeed;
            car.omega = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 19.5; 
            
            car.state = 'crashed';
        }

        function applyDamage(car, worldX, worldY, amount) {
            let angle = car.angle + car.driftAngle;
            let dx = worldX - car.x;
            let dy = worldY - car.y;
            
            let lx = dx * Math.cos(-angle) - dy * Math.sin(-angle);
            let ly = dx * Math.sin(-angle) + dy * Math.cos(-angle);

            const pts = carOutline(car);
            let closestIdx = 0;
            let minDist = Infinity;
            for(let i=0; i<10; i++) {
                let px = pts[i].x + car.damage[i].x;
                let py = pts[i].y + car.damage[i].y;
                let d = Math.hypot(lx - px, ly - py);
                if(d < minDist) {
                    minDist = d;
                    closestIdx = i;
                }
            }

            let px = pts[closestIdx].x;
            let py = pts[closestIdx].y;
            let len = Math.hypot(px, py);
            if(len > 0) {
                car.damage[closestIdx].x -= (px / len) * amount;
                car.damage[closestIdx].y -= (py / len) * amount;
            }
            
            let maxDmg = 10;
            let curDmg = Math.hypot(car.damage[closestIdx].x, car.damage[closestIdx].y);
            if(curDmg > maxDmg) {
                car.damage[closestIdx].x *= maxDmg/curDmg;
                car.damage[closestIdx].y *= maxDmg/curDmg;
            }
        }

        function frontQueueCar() {
            let front = null;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                if (cars[i].state === 'queue' && (!front || cars[i].indexInQueue < front.indexInQueue)) front = cars[i];
            }
            return front;
        }

        // Whether launching queue car `car` after `delay` seconds would get it
        // onto the track without a crash. Follows its path up the entry road,
        // around the merge curve and through its first moments on the track
        // (while it can still collide), checking where each track car will be
        // at the same moment, with a few px of margin.
        const launchProbe = { x: 0, y: 0, angle: 0, isCurve: false, curveDir: 1 };
        function launchIsSafe(car, delay) {
            const R = entryRadius, curveLen = Math.PI * R / 2;
            const mergeY = cy + currentTrack.bottomOff;
            const straight = Math.max(0, car.y - (mergeY + R));
            const pathLen = straight + curveLen + trackSpeed * 0.15; // + its 0.1s collision grace
            const minDist = safeDist + 6;
            for (let s = 0; s <= pathLen; s += 2) {
                let ex, ey, eLift = 0;
                if (s < straight) {
                    ex = cx + R; ey = car.y - s;
                } else if (s < straight + curveLen) {
                    const theta = -((s - straight) / curveLen) * (Math.PI / 2);
                    ex = cx + Math.cos(theta) * R;
                    ey = mergeY + R + Math.sin(theta) * R;
                } else {
                    const d = s - straight - curveLen;
                    updateTrackPosition(launchProbe, d);
                    ex = launchProbe.x; ey = launchProbe.y; eLift = computeLiftF(d);
                }
                const t = delay + s / trackSpeed;
                for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                    const other = cars[i];
                    if (other.state !== 'track' || other.crashed) continue;
                    const d = other.distance + other.actualSpeed * t;
                    if (Math.abs(computeLiftF(d) - eLift) > 0.3) continue;
                    updateTrackPosition(launchProbe, d);
                    if (Math.hypot(launchProbe.x - ex, launchProbe.y - ey) < minDist) return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        function launchCar() {
            let carToEnter = null;
            let minIndex = Infinity;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                if (cars[i].state === 'queue' && cars[i].indexInQueue < minIndex) {
                    minIndex = cars[i].indexInQueue;
                    carToEnter = cars[i];
                }
            }
            
            if (carToEnter) {
                hasLaunchedThisLevel = true;
                carToEnter.state = 'entering_straight';
                
                playSound('move', -13.1, carToEnter.x, carToEnter.y, 0.6+ 0.3*(activeCarsOnTrack%2));
                
                playSound('note', 0, carToEnter.x, carToEnter.y, noteRate(activeCarsOnTrack));
                activeCarsOnTrack++;

                const mergeY = cy + currentTrack.bottomOff;
                for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                    if (cars[i].state === 'queue') {
                        cars[i].indexInQueue--;
                        cars[i].targetY = mergeY + entryRadius + 15 + cars[i].indexInQueue * 45;
                    }
                }

                launchCooldown = (carLength + 1) / trackSpeed;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        function triggerLevelComplete() {
            state = 'levelcomplete';
            updateSkipAdButton();
            levelCompleteTimer = 0;
            endSoundPlayed = false;
            endSoundTime = 0;
            autoAdvanceTriggered = false;
            track('level', level, 'complete');
            pokiGameplayStop();

            finishCarsList = cars.filter(c => c.state === 'track');
            
            finishCarsList.forEach(c => {
                let vx = c.x - cx;
                let vy = c.y - cy;
                if (isReversed) vx = -vx;
                c.finishAngle = Math.atan2(vy, vx);
            });

            let baseAngle = 0;
            if (lastCarEntered && finishCarsList.includes(lastCarEntered)) {
                baseAngle = lastCarEntered.finishAngle;
            } else if (finishCarsList.length > 0) {
                baseAngle = finishCarsList[0].finishAngle;
            }

            finishCarsList.forEach(c => {
                let diff;
                if (!isReversed) {
                    diff = c.finishAngle - baseAngle;
                } else {
                    diff = baseAngle - c.finishAngle;
                }
                while (diff < 0) diff += Math.PI * 2;
                while (diff >= Math.PI * 2) diff -= Math.PI * 2;
                c.angleSortKey = diff;
            });

            finishCarsList.sort((a, b) => a.angleSortKey - b.angleSortKey);
            
            finishCarsList.forEach((c, idx) => {
                c.finishIndex = idx;
                c.finishAnimTriggered = false;
                c.finishLightTimer = 0;
            });
        }

        function update(dt) {
            pulseTime += dt;

            const camLerp = Math.min(1, dt * 7);
            camZoom += (camZoomTarget - camZoom) * camLerp;
            camPan += (camPanTarget - camPan) * camLerp;
            // Land exactly on the target once the difference is sub-pixel, so the
            // zoomed-in track layer can cover the whole view on its own.
            if (Math.abs(camZoomTarget - camZoom) < 0.0005) camZoom = camZoomTarget;
            if (Math.abs(camPanTarget - camPan) < 0.05) camPan = camPanTarget;

            timeScaleTarget = skinMenuOpen ? 0.2 : 1;
            timeScale += (timeScaleTarget - timeScale) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
            if (Math.abs(timeScale - timeScaleTarget) < 0.005) timeScale = timeScaleTarget;
            const sdt = dt * timeScale;

            const partFric = Math.pow(0.01, sdt);
            const crashFric = Math.pow(0.6, sdt);
            const crashRotFric = Math.pow(0.2, sdt);
            const crashLiftFric = Math.pow(0.25, sdt);

            trailFrameAccum += timeScale;
            if (trailFrameAccum >= 1) {
                shouldEmitTrail = true;
                trailFrameAccum -= 1;
                if (trailFrameAccum >= 1) trailFrameAccum = 0;
            } else {
                shouldEmitTrail = false;
            }

            for (let i = fadingCars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                fadingCars[i].fadeTimer -= dt;
                if (fadingCars[i].fadeTimer <= 0) {
                    fadingCars.splice(i, 1);
                }
            }
            for (let i = fadingParticles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                fadingParticles[i].fadeTimer -= dt;
                if (fadingParticles[i].fadeTimer <= 0) {
                    fadingParticles.splice(i, 1);
                }
            }

            if (launchCooldown > 0) {
                launchCooldown -= dt;
            }
            if (restartDriveRate > 0) {
                const front = frontQueueCar();
                if (!front || Math.abs(front.y - front.targetY) <= 5) restartDriveRate = 0;
            }
            if (pendingLaunchTimer >= 0) {
                const front = frontQueueCar();
                if (state !== 'playing' || !front || hasLaunchedThisLevel) {
                    pendingLaunchTimer = -1;
                } else if (launchIsSafe(front, 0)) {
                    pendingLaunchTimer = -1;
                    launchCar();
                } else if ((pendingLaunchTimer -= sdt) < 0) {
                    pendingLaunchTimer = -1; // the gap was missed: the tap is dropped
                }
            }
            if (launchCooldown <= 0 && bufferedLaunches > 0 && state === 'playing') {
                if (launchCar()) {
                    bufferedLaunches = 0; 
                } else {
                    bufferedLaunches = 0; 
                }
            }

            if (state === 'levelcomplete') {
                levelCompleteTimer += dt;
                
                if (finishCarsList) {
                    finishCarsList.forEach(c => {
                        if (!c.finishAnimTriggered && levelCompleteTimer >= c.finishIndex * 0.031) {
                            c.finishAnimTriggered = true;
                            c.finishLightTimer = 0.5;
                            playSound('note', 0, c.x, c.y, noteRate(c.finishIndex));
                        }
                        if (c.finishLightTimer > 0) {
                            c.finishLightTimer -= dt;
                        }
                    });

                    let lastNoteTime = finishCarsList.length > 0 ? (finishCarsList.length - 1) * 0.031 : 0;
                    if (!endSoundPlayed && levelCompleteTimer >= lastNoteTime + 0.11) {
                        playSound('end', -5, cx, cy, 1.0);
                        endSoundPlayed = true;
                        endSoundTime = levelCompleteTimer;

                        finishCarsList.forEach(c => {
                            for(let k=0; k<20; k++) {
                                spawnParticle(c.x, c.y, c.color, 1.5, null, null, 'firework');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }

                if (AUTO_ADVANCE_AFTER_CELEBRATION && endSoundPlayed && !autoAdvanceTriggered &&
                    levelCompleteTimer >= endSoundTime + AUTO_ADVANCE_DELAY) {
                    autoAdvanceTriggered = true;
                    // Deferred so it runs as its own task outside update()'s call
                    // stack, same as the manual tap-to-continue path does (via the
                    // click handler) — a downstream failure here must not be able
                    // to interrupt the render loop mid-frame.
                    setTimeout(proceedToNextLevel, 0);
                }
            }

            if (state !== 'playing' && state !== 'gameover' && state !== 'levelcomplete') return;

            levelElapsedTime += sdt;

            const mergeY = cy + currentTrack.bottomOff;
            const curveLen = Math.PI * entryRadius / 2;
            const topY = cy - currentTrack.topOff;
            const es = currentTrack.exitSide || 1;

            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                let car = cars[i];
                if (car.state === 'dead') continue;
                
                if (car.flashTimer > 0) {
                    car.flashTimer -= sdt;
                }
                if (car.mergeFxT >= 0 && (car.mergeFxT += sdt) > mergeFxTime(car)) car.mergeFxT = -1;

                if (car.state === 'crashed') {
                    car.x += car.vx * sdt;
                    car.y += car.vy * sdt;
                    car.angle += car.omega * sdt;
                    
                    car.vx *= crashFric;
                    car.vy *= crashFric;
                    car.omega *= crashRotFric;
                    if (car.liftF) car.liftF *= crashLiftFric;
                    
                    if (car.historyCount > 0) {
                        car.historyTimer = (car.historyTimer || 0) + sdt;
                        if (car.historyTimer > 0.1 / 12) {
                            car.historyCount--;
                            car.historyTimer = 0;
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                if (car.state === 'queue') {
                    // A sped-up drive-up eases exactly exponentially, so it takes
                    // the same time at any frame rate.
                    const k = restartDriveRate > 0 ? 1 - Math.exp(-restartDriveRate * sdt) : 8 * sdt;
                    car.y += (car.targetY - car.y) * k;
                    car.x = cx + entryRadius;
                    car.angle = -Math.PI/2;
                    car.driftAngle = 0;
                    car.steerAngle = 0;
                    car.liftF = 0;
                } 
                else if (car.state === 'entering_straight') {
                    car.y -= trackSpeed * sdt;
                    car.x = cx + entryRadius;
                    car.angle = -Math.PI/2;
                    car.liftF = 0;
                    
                    if (car.y <= mergeY + entryRadius) {
                        car.state = 'entering_curve';
                        car.entryDist = (mergeY + entryRadius) - car.y; 
                    }
                    addHistory(car);
                }
                else if (car.state === 'entering_curve') {
                    car.entryDist += trackSpeed * sdt;
                    car.liftF = 0;

                    if (car.entryDist >= curveLen) {
                        car.state = 'track';
                        car.distance = car.entryDist - curveLen;
                        car.actualSpeed = trackSpeed;
                        car.collisionGrace = 0.1; 
                        // Merge effect: glow and ring (drawMergeEffects) plus a few
                        // sparks in the car's color.
                        car.mergeFxT = 0;
                        car.mergeFxStrong = car.isPolice;
                        for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) spawnParticle(car.x, car.y, car.color, 0.45, null, null, 'firework');
                        
                        if (car.isPolice && !car.policeActivated) {
                            car.policeActivated = true;
                            // A police car turns the nearest car ahead green, a
                            // fire truck the two nearest.
                            const turns = car.isFireTruck ? 2 : 1;
                            for (let t = 0; t < turns; t++) {
                                let minD = Infinity;
                                let targetCar = null;
                                for (let j = 0; j < cars.length; j++) {
                                    let other = cars[j];
                                    if (other !== car && other.state === 'track' && !other.isPolice && other.color !== exitColor) {
                                        let distAhead = (other.distance - car.distance + currentTrack.perimeter) % currentTrack.perimeter;
                                        if (distAhead < minD) {
                                            minD = distAhead;
                                            targetCar = other;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (!targetCar) break;
                                targetCar.color = exitColor;
                                targetCar.flashTimer = 0.15;
                                targetCar.mergeFxT = 0;
                                targetCar.mergeFxStrong = true;
                                playSound('flash', 0, targetCar.x, targetCar.y, 1 + t * 0.25);
                                for(let k=0; k<20; k++) spawnParticle(targetCar.x, targetCar.y, exitColor, 1.5, null, null, 'firework');
                            }
                            for(let k=0; k<20; k++) spawnParticle(car.x, car.y, exitColor, 1.5, null, null, 'firework');
                       } else if (car.color !== exitColor && !car.isPolice) {
                            lastCarEntered = car;
                            carsAdded++;
                        }

                        if (!isPreloaded && !isWaveLevel && state === 'playing' && carsAdded >= targetCars) {
                            let remainingInQueue = false;
                            for (let j = 0; j < cars.length; j++) {
                                if (cars[j].state === 'queue' || cars[j].state === 'entering_straight' || cars[j].state === 'entering_curve') {
                                    remainingInQueue = true;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            if (!remainingInQueue) {
                                triggerLevelComplete();
                            }
                        }

                        if (isWaveLevel && state === 'playing') {
                            let remainingInQueue = false;
                            for (let j = 0; j < cars.length; j++) {
                                if (cars[j].state === 'queue' || cars[j].state === 'entering_straight' || cars[j].state === 'entering_curve') {
                                    remainingInQueue = true;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            if (!remainingInQueue) {
                                triggerLevelComplete();
                            }
                        }

                    } else {
                        let theta = 0 - (car.entryDist / curveLen) * (Math.PI / 2);
                        car.x = cx + Math.cos(theta) * entryRadius;
                        car.y = mergeY + entryRadius + Math.sin(theta) * entryRadius;
                        car.angle = theta - Math.PI/2; 
                        car.steerAngle = -0.4; 
                    }
                    addHistory(car);
                }
                else if (car.state === 'track') {
                    if (car.collisionGrace > 0) car.collisionGrace -= sdt;

                    if ((car.color === exitColor || car.isPolice) && hasExitRoad) {
                        let d = car.distance % currentTrack.perimeter;
                        if (Math.abs(d - currentTrack.exitDist) < trackSpeed * sdt * 1.5) {
                            car.state = 'exiting_curve';
                            car.exitDist = 0;
                            car.liftF = 0;
                            playSound('exit', 0, car.x, car.y, 0.8 + activeCarsOnTrack %2 * 0.2);
                            activeCarsOnTrack--;
                            continue;
                        }
                    }

                    car.actualSpeed = trackSpeed;
                    car.distance += car.actualSpeed * sdt;

                    updateTrackPosition(car, car.distance);
                    car.liftF = computeLiftF(car.distance);
                    
                    let dirS = car.isCurve ? (car.curveDir || 1) : 1;
                    let targetDrift = car.isCurve ? 0.25 * dirS : 0; 
                    let targetSteer = car.isCurve ? 0.4 * dirS : 0; 
                    
                    car.driftAngle += (targetDrift - car.driftAngle) * 8 * sdt;
                    car.steerAngle += (targetSteer - car.steerAngle) * 12 * sdt;
                    
                    addHistory(car);
                }
                else if (car.state === 'exiting_curve') {
                    car.exitDist += car.actualSpeed * sdt;
                    car.liftF = 0;
                    
                    if (car.exitDist >= curveLen) {
                        car.state = 'exiting_straight';
                        car.x = cx + es * entryRadius;
                        car.angle = -Math.PI/2;
                    } else {
                        let theta = Math.PI/2 - (car.exitDist / curveLen) * (Math.PI / 2);
                        car.x = cx + es * Math.cos(theta) * entryRadius;
                        car.y = topY - entryRadius + Math.sin(theta) * entryRadius;
                        car.angle = es === 1 ? (theta - Math.PI/2) : (Math.PI - (theta - Math.PI/2));
                        car.steerAngle = es === 1 ? -0.4 : 0.4; 
                    }
                    addHistory(car);
                }
                else if (car.state === 'exiting_straight') {
                    car.y -= car.actualSpeed * sdt;
                    car.angle = -Math.PI/2;
                    car.steerAngle *= 0.8;
                    car.driftAngle *= 0.8;
                    car.liftF = 0;

                    addHistory(car);

                    if (car.y < -100) {
                        car.state = 'dead'; 
                    }
                }
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                let c1 = cars[i];
                if (c1.state === 'queue' || c1.state === 'exiting_straight' || c1.state === 'exiting_curve' || c1.state === 'dead') continue;

                for (let j = i + 1; j < cars.length; j++) {
                    let c2 = cars[j];
                    if (c2.state === 'queue' || c2.state === 'exiting_straight' || c2.state === 'exiting_curve' || c2.state === 'dead') continue;

                    let c1Safe = c1.state === 'track' && c1.collisionGrace <= 0 && !c1.crashed;
                    let c2Safe = c2.state === 'track' && c2.collisionGrace <= 0 && !c2.crashed;
                    if (c1Safe && c2Safe) continue;

                    if (Math.abs((c1.liftF || 0) - (c2.liftF || 0)) > 0.3) continue;

                    let dx = c2.x - c1.x;
                    let dy = c2.y - c1.y;
                    let dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
                    
                    if (dist < safeDist) {
                        let firstImpact = (!c1.crashed && !c2.crashed);
                        let bothAlreadyCrashed = c1.crashed && c2.crashed;

                        if (firstImpact && state === 'playing') {
                            state = 'gameover';
                            pokiGameplayStop(); 

                            skinExpanded = false;
                            audioExpanded = false;
                            skinMenuOpen = false;
                            
                            levelLosses[level] = (levelLosses[level] || 0) + 1;
                            let losses = levelLosses[level];
                            let shouldGlow = false;
                            if (level < 20) {
                                if (losses === 5 || losses === 10) shouldGlow = true;
                            } else {
                                if (losses === 10) shouldGlow = true;
                            }

                            if (shouldGlow) {
                                triggerGlow();
                            }

                            // Reveal the slow-down tip text on the 10th (and later) fail,
                            // and the skip button on the 20th.
                            updateTopActionLabel();
                            updateSkipAdButton();
                        }

                        if (!c1.crashed) makeCrashed(c1);
                        if (!c2.crashed) makeCrashed(c2);

                        if (dist === 0) { dx = 1; dy = 0; dist = 1; }
                        let nx = dx / dist;
                        let ny = dy / dist;
                        
                        let dvx = c1.vx - c2.vx;
                        let dvy = c1.vy - c2.vy;
                        let velAlongNormal = dvx * nx + dvy * ny;
                        
                        if (velAlongNormal > 0) {
                            let restitution = 0.7; 
                            let impulse = (1 + restitution) * velAlongNormal / 2;
                            c1.vx -= impulse * nx;
                            c1.vy -= impulse * ny;
                            c2.vx += impulse * nx;
                            c2.vy += impulse * ny;
                            
                            let midX = c1.x + dx/2;
                            let midY = c1.y + dy/2;

                            if (!bothAlreadyCrashed) {
                                let hitDb = -15 + Math.min(1, velAlongNormal / 50) * 10;
                                let hitRate = 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4;
                                playSound('hit', hitDb, midX, midY, hitRate);

                                if (velAlongNormal > 20) {
                                    let dmg = Math.min(8, velAlongNormal / 20);
                                    applyDamage(c1, midX, midY, dmg);
                                    applyDamage(c2, midX, midY, dmg);

                                    let sparkCount = Math.max(10, Math.min(30, Math.floor(velAlongNormal / 5)));
                                    for(let k=0; k<sparkCount; k++) {
                                        spawnParticle(midX, midY, c1.color, 1.5, c1.angle, Math.PI * 2 / 3, 'collision');
                                        spawnParticle(midX, midY, c2.color, 1.5, c2.angle, Math.PI * 2 / 3, 'collision');
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    applyDamage(c1, midX, midY, 1);
                                    applyDamage(c2, midX, midY, 1);
                                    
                                    let sparkCount = 5;
                                    for(let k=0; k<sparkCount; k++) {
                                        spawnParticle(midX, midY, c1.color, 0.8, c1.angle, Math.PI * 2 / 3, 'collision');
                                        spawnParticle(midX, midY, c2.color, 0.8, c2.angle, Math.PI * 2 / 3, 'collision');
                                    }
                                }
                            } else {
                                let dmg = Math.min(8, velAlongNormal / 20);
                                applyDamage(c1, midX, midY, dmg);
                                applyDamage(c2, midX, midY, dmg);
                            }
                        }
                        
                        let percent = 0.5;
                        let slop = 0.5;
                        let penetration = Math.max(safeDist - dist - slop, 0);
                        let correctionX = (penetration / 2) * percent * nx;
                        let correctionY = (penetration / 2) * percent * ny;
                        
                        c1.x -= correctionX;
                        c1.y -= correctionY;
                        c2.x += correctionX;
                        c2.y += correctionY;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < particlePool.length; i++) {
                let p = particlePool[i];
                if (!p.active) continue;
                
                p.vx *= partFric;
                p.vy *= partFric;
                p.omega *= partFric;

                p.x += p.vx * sdt;
                p.y += p.vy * sdt;
                p.angle += p.omega * sdt;
                
                if (p.type === 'firework') {
                    p.life -= p.decay * (sdt * 60);
                    p.size += 0.1 * (sdt * 60);
                }
                
                if (p.life <= 0) {
                    p.active = false;
                }
            }

            if (isPreloaded && state === 'playing') {
                let remaining = false;
                for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                    if (cars[i].state === 'queue' || cars[i].state === 'entering_straight' || cars[i].state === 'entering_curve') {
                        remaining = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!remaining) {
                    triggerLevelComplete();
                }
            }

            if (state === 'playing') {
                maintainQueue();
            }
        }

        function triggerGlow() {
            topActionBtn.classList.add('glow-button');
            if (glowTimeout) clearTimeout(glowTimeout);
            glowTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                topActionBtn.classList.remove('glow-button');
            }, 3000);
        }

        function clearGlow() {
            if (glowTimeout) clearTimeout(glowTimeout);
            topActionBtn.classList.remove('glow-button');
        }

        // The separate skip-level button (rewarded ad) under the slow-down
        // button: shown after SKIP_AD_LOSSES fails on this level, until the
        // level is passed or slow-down is used (its button then turns into a
        // skip button itself).
        const SKIP_AD_LOSSES = 20;
        let lastSkipAdVisibleLevel = -1;
        function updateSkipAdButton() {
            const show = topButtonState === 'slow' && state !== 'levelcomplete' &&
                (levelLosses[level] || 0) >= SKIP_AD_LOSSES;
            skipAdBtn.style.display = show ? 'flex' : 'none';
            skipAdLabel.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none';
            if (!show) return;
            skipAdLabel.textContent = getTranslation('skip').toUpperCase();
            if (lastSkipAdVisibleLevel !== level) {
                lastSkipAdVisibleLevel = level;
                track('button', 'skip-level-ad-' + level, 'visible');
            }
        }

        let trackLayer = document.createElement('canvas');
        let trackLayerValid = false;
        let opLayer = document.createElement('canvas');
        let opLayerValid = false;
        let opLayerInfo = null;

        // Zoomed-in copies, rendered at the full-zoom resolution, so zooming in
        // (level-start flourish, car menu) doesn't redraw the whole track every
        // frame. The track one only covers what the fully zoomed camera shows.
        let trackLayerZ = document.createElement('canvas');
        let trackLayerZValid = false;
        let opLayerZ = document.createElement('canvas');
        let opLayerZValid = false;
        let opLayerZInfo = null;

        function invalidateTrackLayers() {
            trackLayerValid = false;
            opLayerValid = false;
            trackLayerZValid = false;
            opLayerZValid = false;
        }

        // Both track layers hold the track exactly as it appears on screen,
        // mirror included, and are drawn with a plain scale + offset. At rest
        // that's an exact 1:1 copy, which browsers draw far faster than a
        // flipped or resampled one.
        function applyTrackMirror(g) {
            if (isReversed) {
                g.translate(cx, 0);
                g.scale(-1, 1);
                g.translate(-cx, 0);
            }
        }

        // Below this zoom the zoomed layer would be drawn shrunk past ~0.7x
        // (without mipmaps), so the regular layer is scaled up instead.
        const ZOOM_LAYER_MIN = 1.3;
        let trackLayerZPad = 0, trackLayerZPan = 0;

        function ensureZoomTrackLayer() {
            if (trackLayerZValid) return;
            // What camZoomIn() frames, plus a margin for the end of its easing.
            const z = CAM_ZOOM_IN, s = globalScale * z;
            const pad = Math.ceil(6 * s);
            trackLayerZPad = pad;
            trackLayerZPan = -gameHeight * 0.33;
            trackLayerZ.width = canvas.width + pad * 2;
            trackLayerZ.height = canvas.height + pad * 2;
            const g = trackLayerZ.getContext('2d');
            g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            g.clearRect(0, 0, trackLayerZ.width, trackLayerZ.height);
            g.setTransform(s, 0, 0, s,
                globalScale * cx * (1 - z) + pad,
                globalScale * (cy * (1 - z) + trackLayerZPan) + pad);
            applyTrackMirror(g);
            drawTrackInto(g);
            trackLayerZValid = true;
        }

        function ensureTrackLayer() {
            const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
            if (trackLayerValid && trackLayer.width === w && trackLayer.height === h) return;
            trackLayer.width = w;
            trackLayer.height = h;
            const g = trackLayer.getContext('2d');
            g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
            g.scale(globalScale, globalScale);
            applyTrackMirror(g);
            drawTrackInto(g);
            trackLayerValid = true;
        }

        function drawRegularTrackLayer(z) {
            ensureTrackLayer();
            ctx.setTransform(z, 0, 0, z, globalScale * cx * (1 - z), globalScale * (cy * (1 - z) + camPan));
            ctx.drawImage(trackLayer, 0, 0);
        }

        function drawTrackLayers() {
            const z = camZoom, gs = globalScale;
            if (z >= ZOOM_LAYER_MIN) {
                ensureZoomTrackLayer();
                // Maps the zoomed layer (rendered at CAM_ZOOM_IN) onto the current camera.
                const Z = CAM_ZOOM_IN, k = z / Z, pad = trackLayerZPad;
                const tx = gs * cx * (1 - z) - k * (gs * cx * (1 - Z) + pad);
                const ty = gs * (cy * (1 - z) + camPan) - k * (gs * (cy * (1 - Z) + trackLayerZPan) + pad);
                // While still zooming, the view can reach past the zoomed layer,
                // so the regular layer fills in underneath it.
                if (tx > 0.5 || ty > 0.5 ||
                    tx + k * trackLayerZ.width < canvas.width - 0.5 ||
                    ty + k * trackLayerZ.height < canvas.height - 0.5) {
                    drawRegularTrackLayer(z);
                }
                ctx.setTransform(k, 0, 0, k, tx, ty);
                ctx.drawImage(trackLayerZ, 0, 0);
            } else {
                drawRegularTrackLayer(z);
            }
            resetToBaseTransform();
        }

        // Renders the overpass into `layer` at `scale` pixels per unit; returns
        // where to draw it (null if the track has no overpass).
        function renderOverpassLayer(layer, scale) {
            const ops = currentTrack.opInfos;
            if (!ops) return null;
            const m = trackWidth / 2 + 14;
            let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
            for (const op of ops) {
                minX = Math.min(minX, op.bx0, op.bx1); maxX = Math.max(maxX, op.bx0, op.bx1);
                minY = Math.min(minY, op.by0, op.by1); maxY = Math.max(maxY, op.by0, op.by1);
            }
            const bx = cx + minX - m, by = cy + minY - m;
            const bw = maxX - minX + m * 2, bh = maxY - minY + m * 2;
            layer.width = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(bw * scale));
            layer.height = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(bh * scale));
            const g = layer.getContext('2d');
            g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            g.clearRect(0, 0, layer.width, layer.height);
            g.scale(scale, scale);
            g.translate(-bx, -by);
            drawOverpassInto(g);
            return { x: bx, y: by, w: bw, h: bh };
        }

        function ensureOverpassLayer() {
            if (opLayerValid) return;
            opLayerInfo = renderOverpassLayer(opLayer, globalScale);
            opLayerValid = true;
        }

        function ensureZoomOverpassLayer() {
            if (opLayerZValid) return;
            opLayerZInfo = renderOverpassLayer(opLayerZ, globalScale * CAM_ZOOM_IN);
            opLayerZValid = true;
        }

        function strokeTrackPath(g) {
            g.save();
            g.translate(cx, cy);
            g.lineWidth = trackWidth;
            g.strokeStyle = '#334155';
            g.stroke(currentTrack.path2d);
            g.lineWidth = 4;
            g.strokeStyle = '#475569';
            g.stroke(currentTrack.path2d);
            g.restore();
        }

        function drawTrackInto(g) {
            g.save();
            const mergeY = cy + currentTrack.bottomOff;
            const topY = cy - currentTrack.topOff;
            const es = currentTrack.exitSide || 1;

            strokeTrackPath(g);

            if (hasExitRoad) {
                const exitArc = (rad) => {
                    g.beginPath();
                    if (es === 1) g.arc(cx, topY - entryRadius, rad, Math.PI/2, 0, true);
                    else g.arc(cx, topY - entryRadius, rad, Math.PI/2, Math.PI, false);
                };
                const vx = cx + es * entryRadius;

                g.lineWidth = trackWidth;
                g.strokeStyle = '#334155';
                exitArc(entryRadius);
                g.stroke();
                g.fillStyle = '#334155';
                g.fillRect(vx - trackWidth/2, -100, trackWidth, topY - entryRadius + 100 + 1);

                g.lineWidth = 4;
                g.strokeStyle = exitColor; 
                exitArc(entryRadius - trackWidth/2);
                g.stroke();
                exitArc(entryRadius + trackWidth/2);
                g.stroke();
                
                g.beginPath();
                g.moveTo(vx - trackWidth/2, -100);
                g.lineTo(vx - trackWidth/2, topY - entryRadius + 1);
                g.stroke();
                g.beginPath();
                g.moveTo(vx + trackWidth/2, -100);
                g.lineTo(vx + trackWidth/2, topY - entryRadius + 1);
                g.stroke();

                exitArc(entryRadius);
                g.moveTo(vx, topY - entryRadius + 1);
                g.lineTo(vx, -100);
                g.lineWidth = 2;
                g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)';
                g.setLineDash([20, 20]);
                g.stroke();
                g.setLineDash([]);

                g.fillStyle = 'rgba(46, 213, 115, 0.5)';
                g.beginPath();
                g.moveTo(vx, topY - entryRadius - 55); 
                g.lineTo(vx - 20, topY - entryRadius - 20);
                g.lineTo(vx + 20, topY - entryRadius - 20);
                g.closePath();
                g.fill();
            }

            g.lineWidth = trackWidth;
            g.strokeStyle = '#334155';
            g.beginPath();
            g.arc(cx, mergeY + entryRadius, entryRadius, 0, -Math.PI/2, true);
            g.stroke();
            g.fillStyle = '#334155';
            g.fillRect(cx + entryRadius - trackWidth/2, mergeY + entryRadius - 1, trackWidth, gameHeight);

            g.lineWidth = 4;
            g.strokeStyle = '#475569';
            g.beginPath();
            g.arc(cx, mergeY + entryRadius, entryRadius - trackWidth/2, 0, -Math.PI/2, true);
            g.stroke();
            g.beginPath();
            g.arc(cx, mergeY + entryRadius, entryRadius + trackWidth/2, 0, -Math.PI/2, true);
            g.stroke();
            g.beginPath();
            g.moveTo(cx + entryRadius - trackWidth/2, mergeY + entryRadius - 1);
            g.lineTo(cx + entryRadius - trackWidth/2, gameHeight);
            g.stroke();
            g.beginPath();
            g.moveTo(cx + entryRadius + trackWidth/2, mergeY + entryRadius - 1);
            g.lineTo(cx + entryRadius + trackWidth/2, gameHeight);
            g.stroke();

            g.beginPath();
            g.arc(cx, mergeY + entryRadius, entryRadius, 0, -Math.PI/2, true);
            g.moveTo(cx + entryRadius, mergeY + entryRadius - 1);
            g.lineTo(cx + entryRadius, gameHeight);
            g.lineWidth = 2;
            g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)';
            g.setLineDash([20, 20]);
            g.stroke();
            g.setLineDash([]);

            strokeTrackPath(g);

            g.save();
            g.translate(cx, cy);
            g.lineWidth = 2;
            g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
            g.setLineDash([20, 20]);
            g.stroke(currentTrack.path2d);
            g.setLineDash([]);
            g.restore();

            g.restore();
        }

        function drawOverpassInto(g) {
            const ops = currentTrack.opInfos;
            if (!ops) return;
            for (const op of ops) drawBridgeInto(g, op);
        }

        function drawBridgeInto(g, op) {
            const x0 = cx + op.bx0, y0 = cy + op.by0;
            const x1 = cx + op.bx1, y1 = cy + op.by1;
            const ex = op.nx * (trackWidth / 2 - 2), ey = op.ny * (trackWidth / 2 - 2);
            g.save();
            g.lineCap = 'butt';
            g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.45)';
            g.lineWidth = trackWidth + 12;
            g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x0, y0); g.lineTo(x1, y1); g.stroke();
            g.strokeStyle = '#334155';
            g.lineWidth = trackWidth;
            g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x0, y0); g.lineTo(x1, y1); g.stroke();
            g.strokeStyle = '#475569';
            g.lineWidth = 4;
            g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x0 + ex, y0 + ey); g.lineTo(x1 + ex, y1 + ey); g.stroke();
            g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x0 - ex, y0 - ey); g.lineTo(x1 - ex, y1 - ey); g.stroke();
            g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
            g.lineWidth = 2;
            g.setLineDash([20, 20]);
            g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x0, y0); g.lineTo(x1, y1); g.stroke();
            g.setLineDash([]);
            g.restore();
        }

        function drawOverpass() {
            let layer = opLayer, info;
            if (camZoom < ZOOM_LAYER_MIN) {
                ensureOverpassLayer();
                info = opLayerInfo;
            } else {
                ensureZoomOverpassLayer();
                layer = opLayerZ;
                info = opLayerZInfo;
            }
            if (info) ctx.drawImage(layer, info.x, info.y, info.w, info.h);
        }

        function drawTrailForCar(car, isFading) {
            if (car.state === 'dead') return;
            const n = car.historyCount;
            if (n > 0) {
                // The trail stays within ~50px behind its car.
                if (!inView(car.x, car.y, 100)) return;
                const spr = getTrailSprite(car.color);
                const fade = isFading ? Math.max(0, car.fadeTimer / 0.3) : 1;
                const trailScale = car.isFireTruck ? FT_TRAIL_SCALE : carVisualScale;
                // j = 0 is fully transparent, so it's skipped.
                for (let j = 1; j < n; j++) {
                    let idx = (car.historyIdx - n + j + 12) % 12;
                    let h = car.history[idx];
                    ctx.globalAlpha = (j / n) * 0.31 * fade;
                    const a = h.angle + h.driftAngle;
                    setLocalTransform(h.x, h.y, Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a), trailScale);
                    drawCell(ctx, spr);
                }
            }
        }

        function drawTrails(pass) {
            if (!showTrails) return;
            
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

            for (let i = 0; i < fadingCars.length; i++) {
                const c = fadingCars[i];
                if (pass === 1 && isLifted(c)) continue;
                if (pass === 2 && !isLifted(c)) continue;
                drawTrailForCar(c, true);
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                const c = cars[i];
                if (pass === 1 && isLifted(c)) continue;
                if (pass === 2 && !isLifted(c)) continue;
                drawTrailForCar(c, false);
            }

            ctx.restore();
        }

        // Derived colors for the car drawn in code, cached per color rather
        // than re-derived (with string parsing) for every car, every frame.
        const carColorCache = {};
        function getCarColors(hex) {
            let c = carColorCache[hex];
            if (!c) {
                const rgb = hexToRgb(hex);
                const hsl = rgbToHsl(rgb.r, rgb.g, rgb.b);
                hsl.l = Math.max(0, hsl.l - 0.2);
                const d = hslToRgb(hsl.h, hsl.s, hsl.l);
                c = {
                    dim: `rgb(${Math.floor(rgb.r * 0.4)}, ${Math.floor(rgb.g * 0.4)}, ${Math.floor(rgb.b * 0.4)})`,
                    dark: `rgb(${d.r}, ${d.g}, ${d.b})`,
                    dimDark: `rgb(${Math.floor(d.r * 0.4)}, ${Math.floor(d.g * 0.4)}, ${Math.floor(d.b * 0.4)})`
                };
                carColorCache[hex] = c;
            }
            return c;
        }

        function traceCarPoly(c, car) {
            const pts = carOutline(car);
            c.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                let px = pts[i].x + car.damage[i].x;
                let py = pts[i].y + car.damage[i].y;
                if (i === 0) c.moveTo(px, py);
                else c.lineTo(px, py);
            }
            c.closePath();
            c.lineJoin = 'round';
            c.lineWidth = 6;
        }

        function drawCarPoly(ctx, car, isShadow, isDimmed) {
            traceCarPoly(ctx, car);
            
            if(isShadow) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)';
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)';
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.fill();
            } else {
                let color = car.flashTimer > 0 ? '#ffffff' : car.color;
                
                if (isDimmed && car.flashTimer <= 0) {
                    color = getCarColors(color).dim;
                }
                
                ctx.strokeStyle = color;
                ctx.fillStyle = color;
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        // The underside layer of the car drawn in code (car-local units).
        function drawVectorCarUnderside(c, car, isDimmed) {
            traceCarPoly(c, car);
            let dColor = getCarColors(car.color).dark;
            if (isDimmed && car.flashTimer <= 0) {
                dColor = getCarColors(car.color).dimDark;
            } else if (car.flashTimer > 0) {
                dColor = '#cccccc';
            }
            c.fillStyle = dColor;
            c.strokeStyle = dColor;
            c.fill();
            c.stroke();
        }

        // The body layer of the car drawn in code: paint, windows, bumper, lights.
        function drawVectorCarBody(c, car, isDimmed) {
            drawCarPoly(c, car, false, isDimmed);

            c.fillStyle = isDimmed ? '#070b15' : '#0f172a';
            roundRect(c, -carLength/6-1, -carWidth/2 + 3, carLength/2.2, carWidth - 6, 3);
            c.fill();

            c.fillStyle = isDimmed ? '#080808' : '#111';
            roundRect(c, -carLength/2 - 2, -carWidth/2 + 1, 4, carWidth - 2, 1);
            c.fill();

            c.fillStyle = isDimmed ? '#666666' : '#ffffff';
            c.beginPath();
            c.arc(carLength/2 - 2, -carWidth/2 + 4, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
            c.arc(carLength/2 - 2, carWidth/2 - 4, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
            c.fill();
        }

        // The fire truck's body layer (car-local units, +x forward): red body,
        // darker rear deck with a ladder, glass, light bar base, step bumper and
        // headlights. The light bar's lamps flash, so drawCar() adds them.
        function drawFireTruckBody(c, car, isDimmed) {
            drawCarPoly(c, car, false, isDimmed);
            const dim = isDimmed && car.flashTimer <= 0;
            const shades = getCarColors(car.color);

            c.fillStyle = dim ? shades.dimDark : shades.dark;
            roundRect(c, -19.5, -7, 15.5, 14, 2);
            c.fill();

            c.fillStyle = dim ? '#5b5e62' : '#e3e7ec';
            c.fillRect(-21, -3.6, 18.5, 1.3);
            c.fillRect(-21, 2.3, 18.5, 1.3);
            for (let x = -19.5; x < -3; x += 3) c.fillRect(x, -2.5, 1, 5);

            c.fillStyle = dim ? '#070b15' : '#0f172a';
            roundRect(c, 6, -6.5, 5, 13, 2);
            c.fill();
            roundRect(c, -2.2, -6, 1.8, 12, 0.8);
            c.fill();

            c.fillStyle = dim ? '#080808' : '#151515';
            roundRect(c, 1.3, -7.5, 3, 15, 1.2);
            c.fill();

            c.fillStyle = dim ? '#080808' : '#111';
            roundRect(c, -23, -8.5, 4, 17, 1);
            c.fill();

            c.fillStyle = dim ? '#666666' : '#ffffff';
            c.beginPath();
            c.arc(17.5, -5.5, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
            c.arc(17.5, 5.5, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
            c.fill();
        }

        function drawCarShadowSilhouette(c, car) {
            traceCarPoly(c, car);
            c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)';
            c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)';
            c.fill();
            c.stroke();
        }

        function drawFinishLightPoly(c, car) {
            traceCarPoly(c, car);
            c.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            c.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            c.fill();
            c.stroke();
        }

        // ---- Sprite set for the car drawn in code (car 0) ----
        // The same layers drawCar() draws as paths, pre-rendered per color at a
        // resolution that stays sharp at full zoom, so a field of cars is a few
        // batched sprite draws instead of ~10 path fills per car. Dented or
        // flashing cars still draw as paths.
        let vectorCarSet = null;
        let fireTruckSet = null;   // the same for the fire truck

        function buildVectorCarSet() {
            // Car-local extent including the stroke: x in [-20, 18], |y| <= 9.5.
            vectorCarSet = buildVectorSpriteSet(allColors.slice(), { x0: -20, x1: 18, y: 9.5 }, false);
        }

        function buildFireTruckSet() {
            fireTruckSet = buildVectorSpriteSet([fireTruckColor], { x0: -23, x1: 19.5, y: 11 }, true);
        }

        // `ext` is the car-local extent including the stroke: x in [x0, x1], |y| <= y.
        function buildVectorSpriteSet(colors, ext, isFireTruck) {
            const S = Math.min(5, Math.max(3, Math.ceil(getDpr() * 1.3 * CAM_ZOOM_IN)));
            const cw = carCellSize((Math.max(-ext.x0, ext.x1) + 1) * 2 * S + CAR_CELL_PAD * 2);
            const ch = carCellSize((ext.y + 1.5) * 2 * S + CAR_CELL_PAD * 2);
            const bounds = { x0: ext.x0 * S - 1, x1: ext.x1 * S + 1, y0: -ext.y * S - 1, y1: ext.y * S + 1 };
            const page = createCarAtlas(cw, ch, 7 + colors.length * 4);
            const cell = (draw) => renderCarCell(page, cw, ch, S, bounds, (g) => {
                g.scale(S, S);
                draw(g);
            });
            const car = { damage: Array.from({ length: 10 }, () => ({ x: 0, y: 0 })), flashTimer: 0, color: '#ffffff', isFireTruck };
            const drawBody = isFireTruck ? drawFireTruckBody : drawVectorCarBody;
            const set = { scale: S, pre: {}, dim: {}, dark: {}, dimDark: {} };
            // Shadows and the finish flash can be drawn with a partial alpha, so
            // their stroke and fill are also separate cells, which then blend
            // exactly like the paths did. At full alpha the combined cell is used.
            set.shadow = cell((g) => drawCarPoly(g, car, true, false));
            set.shadowStroke = cell((g) => { traceCarPoly(g, car); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)'; g.stroke(); });
            set.shadowFill = cell((g) => { traceCarPoly(g, car); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)'; g.fill(); });
            set.dynShadowFill = cell((g) => { traceCarPoly(g, car); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)'; g.fill(); });
            set.dynShadowStroke = cell((g) => { traceCarPoly(g, car); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)'; g.stroke(); });
            set.finishFill = cell((g) => { traceCarPoly(g, car); g.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; g.fill(); });
            set.finishStroke = cell((g) => { traceCarPoly(g, car); g.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; g.stroke(); });
            for (const color of colors) {
                car.color = color;
                set.pre[color] = cell((g) => drawBody(g, car, false));
                set.dim[color] = cell((g) => drawBody(g, car, true));
                set.dark[color] = cell((g) => drawVectorCarUnderside(g, car, false));
                set.dimDark[color] = cell((g) => drawVectorCarUnderside(g, car, true));
            }
            buildCarAtlasLevels(page);
            return set;
        }

        function hasDamage(car) {
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                if (Math.abs(car.damage[i].x) > 0.01 || Math.abs(car.damage[i].y) > 0.01) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        function applyDeformationClip(ctx, car) {
            const pts = carOutline(car);
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                let bx = pts[i].x;
                let by = pts[i].y;
                let len = Math.hypot(bx, by);
                let pad = 4; 
                let px = bx + (bx / len) * pad + car.damage[i].x;
                let py = by + (by / len) * pad + car.damage[i].y;
                
                if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
                else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
            }
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.clip();
        }

        // Which shrunk copy of the car sprites to draw this frame (set in draw()).
        let imgCarLevel = 0, vecCarLevel = 0;

        // Image-car sprite cell, clipped to the dented outline if damaged.
        function drawCarImageCell(cell, car, damaged) {
            if (damaged) {
                ctx.save();
                applyDeformationClip(ctx, car);
                drawCarCell(ctx, cell, imgCarLevel);
                ctx.restore();
            } else {
                drawCarCell(ctx, cell, imgCarLevel);
            }
        }

        // Draws one car. Sets its own transform/alpha for every layer; drawCars()
        // puts the base transform back afterwards.
        function drawCar(car, isFading) {
            if (car.state === 'dead') return;
            if (!inView(car.x, car.y, 40)) return;

            let isDimmed = car.state === 'crashed' || isFading;
            const flashing = car.flashTimer > 0;
            const damaged = hasDamage(car);
            // Fire trucks are always drawn in code, at their own size.
            const ft = car.isFireTruck;
            const vSet = ft ? fireTruckSet : vectorCarSet;
            let useImg = !ft && carImageLoaded && preRenderedCars[car.color] && shadowCarImg;
            const vec = (!useImg && !damaged && !flashing && vSet && vSet.pre[car.color]) ? vSet : null;
            const fade = isFading ? Math.max(0, car.fadeTimer / 0.3) : 1;

            const vScale = ft ? 1 : carVisualScale;
            const ang = car.angle + car.driftAngle;
            const ca = Math.cos(ang), sa = Math.sin(ang);

            let shadowAlpha = 1.0;
            if (g_lightK > 0) {
                shadowAlpha = 1.0 - Math.min(1, g_lightK / 0.6);
            }
            
            if (shadowAlpha > 0.01) {
                ctx.globalAlpha = shadowAlpha * fade;
                setLocalTransform(car.x, car.y + 8, ca, sa, vScale);
                if (useImg) {
                    drawCarImageCell(shadowCarImg, car, damaged);
                } else if (vec) {
                    if (shadowAlpha * fade >= 0.999) {
                        drawCarCell(ctx, vec.shadow, vecCarLevel);
                    } else {
                        drawCarCell(ctx, vec.shadowStroke, vecCarLevel);
                        drawCarCell(ctx, vec.shadowFill, vecCarLevel);
                    }
                } else {
                    drawCarPoly(ctx, car, true, isDimmed);
                }
            }

            ctx.globalAlpha = fade;
            setLocalTransform(car.x, car.y + 3, ca, sa, vScale);
            if (useImg) {
                let dImg;
                if (flashing) dImg = darkPreRenderedCars['#ffffff'];
                else dImg = isDimmed ? dimDarkPreRenderedCars[car.color] : darkPreRenderedCars[car.color];
                if (dImg) drawCarImageCell(dImg, car, damaged);
            } else if (vec) {
                drawCarCell(ctx, isDimmed ? vec.dimDark[car.color] : vec.dark[car.color], vecCarLevel);
            } else {
                drawVectorCarUnderside(ctx, car, isDimmed);
            }

            // Wheels (not scaled with the car).
            const wheelDrop = 2.5 * Math.abs(ca);
            const wy = car.y + wheelDrop;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111111';
            const wLen = 8;
            const wWid = 4;
            const wY = 9; 
            const wXFront = ft ? 11 : carLength/2 - 6;
            const wXRear = ft ? -12.5 : -carLength/2 + 6;
            // The fire truck's rear wheels are doubled up and stick out further.
            const wYRear = ft ? 10.2 : wY;
            const wWidRear = ft ? 5.5 : wWid;

            setLocalTransform(car.x, wy, ca, sa, 1);
