            ctx.fillRect(wXRear - wLen/2, -wYRear - wWidRear/2, wLen, wWidRear);
            ctx.fillRect(wXRear - wLen/2, wYRear - wWidRear/2, wLen, wWidRear);

            // Front wheels pivot at (wXFront, -/+wY) and turn by the steer angle.
            const sAng = ang + car.steerAngle;
            const sc = Math.cos(sAng), ss = Math.sin(sAng);
            setLocalTransform(car.x + wXFront * ca + wY * sa, wy + wXFront * sa - wY * ca, sc, ss, 1);
            ctx.fillRect(-wLen/2, -wWid/2, wLen, wWid);
            setLocalTransform(car.x + wXFront * ca - wY * sa, wy + wXFront * sa + wY * ca, sc, ss, 1);
            ctx.fillRect(-wLen/2, -wWid/2, wLen, wWid);

            setLocalTransform(car.x, car.y, ca, sa, vScale);

            if (useImg) {
                let img;
                if (flashing) img = preRenderedCars['#ffffff'];
                else img = isDimmed ? dimPreRenderedCars[car.color] : preRenderedCars[car.color];
                if (img) drawCarImageCell(img, car, damaged);
            } else if (vec) {
                drawCarCell(ctx, isDimmed ? vec.dim[car.color] : vec.pre[car.color], vecCarLevel);
            } else if (ft) {
                drawFireTruckBody(ctx, car, isDimmed);
            } else {
                drawVectorCarBody(ctx, car, isDimmed);
            }

            if (ft) {
                // Roof light bar: a red and a white lamp taking turns.
                let isRed = (Math.floor(pulseTime * 12) % 2 === 0);

                ctx.fillStyle = isRed ? (isDimmed ? '#551111' : '#ff3b30') : (isDimmed ? '#220000' : '#5c1414');
                roundRect(ctx, 1.8, -7, 2, 6, 1);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.fillStyle = !isRed ? (isDimmed ? '#555555' : '#ffffff') : (isDimmed ? '#151515' : '#4d4d4d');
                roundRect(ctx, 1.8, 1, 2, 6, 1);
                ctx.fill();
                if (car.policeActivated && !isDimmed) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(2.8, isRed ? -4 : 4, 18, 0, Math.PI*2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = isRed ? 'rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.4)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            } else if (car.isPolice || car.color === policeColor) {
                let isRed = (Math.floor(pulseTime * 10) % 2 === 0);
                
                ctx.fillStyle = isRed ? (isDimmed ? '#551111' : '#ff4757') : (isDimmed ? '#220000' : '#551111');
                roundRect(ctx, -2, -carWidth/2 + 2, 4, 4, 1);
                ctx.fill();
                if (isRed && car.policeActivated && !isDimmed) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(0, -carWidth/2 + 4, 18, 0, Math.PI*2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.4)';
                    ctx.fill();
                }

                ctx.fillStyle = !isRed ? (isDimmed ? '#111155' : '#1e90ff') : (isDimmed ? '#000022' : '#111155');
                roundRect(ctx, -2, carWidth/2 - 6, 4, 4, 1);
                ctx.fill();
                if (!isRed && car.policeActivated && !isDimmed) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(0, carWidth/2 - 4, 18, 0, Math.PI*2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30, 144, 255, 0.4)';
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            }

            if (car.finishLightTimer > 0) {
                ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, (car.finishLightTimer / 0.95) * 2.95);
                if (vSet && !damaged) {
                    drawCarCell(ctx, vSet.finishFill, vecCarLevel);
                    drawCarCell(ctx, vSet.finishStroke, vecCarLevel);
                } else {
                    drawFinishLightPoly(ctx, car);
                }
            }
        }

        const DRAW_ORDER = ['queue', 'entering_straight', 'entering_curve', 'exiting_curve', 'exiting_straight', 'track', 'crashed'];

        function drawCars(pass) {
            for (let i = 0; i < fadingCars.length; i++) {
                const c = fadingCars[i];
                if (pass === 1 && isLifted(c)) continue;
                if (pass === 2 && !isLifted(c)) continue;
                drawCar(c, true);
            }

            for (let s = 0; s < DRAW_ORDER.length; s++) {
                let stateToDraw = DRAW_ORDER[s];
                for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                    const c = cars[i];
                    if (c.state !== stateToDraw) continue;
                    if (pass === 1 && isLifted(c)) continue;
                    if (pass === 2 && !isLifted(c)) continue;
                    drawCar(c, false);
                }
            }

            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
            resetToBaseTransform();
        }

        function buildBeamSprite() {
            const scale = BEAM_SCALE;
            const len = BEAM_LEN * scale;
            const frontWidth = 14 * scale;
            const backWidth = 75 * scale;
            const pad = 30 * scale;

            const W = Math.ceil(len + pad * 2);
            const H = Math.ceil(backWidth + pad * 2);

            let c = document.createElement('canvas');
            c.width = W;
            c.height = H;
            const cc = c.getContext('2d');

            const ox = pad;
            const oy = H / 2;
            beamSpriteOX = ox / scale;
            beamSpriteOY = oy / scale;

            cc.translate(ox, oy);

            cc.save();
            cc.filter = `blur(${8 * scale}px)`;

            let grad = cc.createLinearGradient(0, 0, len, 0);
            grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 248, 220, 0.7)');
            grad.addColorStop(0.2, 'rgba(255, 238, 190, 0.4)');
            grad.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(255, 230, 170, 0.15)');
            grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 230, 170, 0)');

            cc.fillStyle = grad;
            cc.beginPath();
            cc.moveTo(0, -frontWidth / 2);
            cc.lineTo(len, -backWidth / 2);
            cc.lineTo(len, backWidth / 2);
            cc.lineTo(0, frontWidth / 2);
            cc.closePath();
            cc.fill();
            cc.restore();

            cc.save();
            const dotRadius = 2.5 * scale;
            const lampY = LAMP_OFF * scale;
            
            for (let s of [-1, 1]) {
                let dotG = cc.createRadialGradient(0, lampY * s, 0, 0, lampY * s, dotRadius * 2.5);
                dotG.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)');
                dotG.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255, 255, 220, 0.8)');
                dotG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 220, 0)');
                cc.fillStyle = dotG;
                cc.beginPath();
                cc.arc(0, lampY * s, dotRadius * 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                cc.fill();
            }
            cc.restore();

            // Crop the margin the blur leaves (nearly) empty: every beam is a
            // large screen-blended fill, drawn once per car each frame while
            // zoomed in, so this cuts a lot of pixel work. Pixels with alpha
            // <= 1/255 add at most one 8-bit step of light, i.e. nothing visible.
            try {
                const data = cc.getImageData(0, 0, W, H).data;
                let minX = W, minY = H, maxX = -1, maxY = -1;
                for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
                    let row = y * W * 4 + 3;
                    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++, row += 4) {
                        if (data[row] > 1) {
                            if (x < minX) minX = x;
                            if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
                            if (y < minY) minY = y;
                            if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (maxX >= 0) {
                    const t = document.createElement('canvas');
                    t.width = maxX - minX + 1;
                    t.height = maxY - minY + 1;
                    t.getContext('2d').drawImage(c, -minX, -minY);
                    beamSpriteOX = (ox - minX) / scale;
                    beamSpriteOY = (oy - minY) / scale;
                    c = t;
                }
            } catch (e) {}

            const dw = c.width / scale, dh = c.height / scale;
            beamReach = Math.hypot(Math.max(beamSpriteOX, dw - beamSpriteOX), Math.max(beamSpriteOY, dh - beamSpriteOY));
            beamSprite = c;
        }

        // Light sources are pooled objects, refilled every frame.
        const lightSourcePool = [];
        function prepareLighting() {
            let k = (camZoom - 1) / (CAM_ZOOM_IN - 1);
            k = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, k));
            if (!lightingEnabled) k = 0;
            g_lightK = k;
            g_lightSources.length = 0;
            if (k <= 0.02) return;

            const frontDist = (carLength / 2 - 1) * carVisualScale;

            let topQueueCar = null;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                if (cars[i].state === 'queue') {
                    if (!topQueueCar || cars[i].indexInQueue < topQueueCar.indexInQueue) {
                        topQueueCar = cars[i];
                    }
                }
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                let car = cars[i];
                if (car.state === 'dead') continue;

                if (car.state === 'queue' && car !== topQueueCar) {
                    continue;
                }

                let ang = car.angle + car.driftAngle;
                let ca = Math.cos(ang), sa = Math.sin(ang);
                const fd = car.isFireTruck ? FT_FRONT_DIST : frontDist;
                let fx = car.x + ca * fd, fy = car.y + sa * fd;
                if (!isFinite(fx) || !isFinite(fy)) continue;
                const n = g_lightSources.length;
                let src = lightSourcePool[n];
                if (!src) src = lightSourcePool[n] = { x: 0, y: 0, ca: 0, sa: 1, ang: 0, int: 1, car: null, lifted: false };
                src.x = fx; src.y = fy; src.ca = ca; src.sa = sa; src.ang = ang;
                src.int = car.crashed ? 0.3 : 1;
                src.car = car;
                src.lifted = isLifted(car);
                g_lightSources.push(src);
            }
        }

        function drawHeadlightBeams(pass) {
            if (g_lightK <= 0.02 || !beamSprite) return;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
            const dw = beamSprite.width / BEAM_SCALE;
            const dh = beamSprite.height / BEAM_SCALE;
            const reach = beamReach * carVisualScale;
            for (let j = 0; j < g_lightSources.length; j++) {
                let src = g_lightSources[j];
                if (pass === 1 && src.lifted) continue;
                if (pass === 2 && !src.lifted) continue;
                if (!inView(src.x, src.y, reach)) continue;
                ctx.globalAlpha = src.int * g_lightK;
                setLocalTransform(src.x, src.y, src.ca, src.sa, carVisualScale);
                ctx.drawImage(beamSprite, -beamSpriteOX, -beamSpriteOY, dw, dh);
            }
            ctx.restore();
        }

        const CONE_COS_INNER = Math.cos(0.24);
        const CONE_COS_OUTER = Math.cos(0.46);
        function coneEdge(dot) {
            let e = (dot - CONE_COS_OUTER) / (CONE_COS_INNER - CONE_COS_OUTER);
            return e <= 0 ? 0 : (e >= 1 ? 1 : e * e * (3 - 2 * e));
        }

        // The (up to) two nearest lights casting a shadow of the current car,
        // nearest first. Reused objects, so no per-frame allocations.
        const shadowContribs = [{ ux: 0, uy: 0, strength: 0, d: 0 }, { ux: 0, uy: 0, strength: 0, d: 0 }];
        function drawDynamicShadows() {
            if (g_lightK <= 0.02) return;
            const maxRange = BEAM_LEN + 15;
            const useImg = carImageLoaded && shadowCarImg;
            const ramp = Math.min(1, g_lightK / 0.6);

            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                let target = cars[i];
                if (target.state === 'dead') continue;
                if (!inView(target.x, target.y, 60)) continue;

                let n = 0;
                const ty = target.y;

                for (let j = 0; j < g_lightSources.length; j++) {
                    let src = g_lightSources[j];
                    if (src.car === target) continue;
                    let dx = target.x - src.x, dy = ty - src.y;
                    let d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
                    if (d < 6 || d > maxRange) continue;
                    let dot = (dx * src.ca + dy * src.sa) / d;
                    let edge = coneEdge(dot);
                    if (edge <= 0) continue;
                    let strength = (1 - d / maxRange) * src.int * edge;
                    if (strength <= 0.02) continue;
                    // Keep the two nearest (ties keep the earlier one first).
                    let slot;
                    if (n === 0) {
                        slot = 0; n = 1;
                    } else if (d < shadowContribs[0].d) {
                        const t = shadowContribs[1];
                        shadowContribs[1] = shadowContribs[0];
                        shadowContribs[0] = t;
                        slot = 0;
                        if (n < 2) n = 2;
                    } else if (n === 1 || d < shadowContribs[1].d) {
                        slot = 1; n = 2;
                    } else {
                        continue;
                    }
                    const cc = shadowContribs[slot];
                    cc.ux = dx / d; cc.uy = dy / d; cc.strength = strength; cc.d = d;
                }
                if (n === 0) continue;

                let ang = target.angle + target.driftAngle;
                const ca = Math.cos(ang), sa = Math.sin(ang);
                const ft = target.isFireTruck;
                const tImg = useImg && !ft;
                const vSet = ft ? fireTruckSet : vectorCarSet;
                const vs = (ft ? 1 : carVisualScale) * (1 + (target.liftF || 0) * LIFT_SCALE);
                const vec = (!tImg && vSet && !hasDamage(target)) ? vSet : null;
                for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    let cc = shadowContribs[k];
                    let offsetLen = (4 + cc.strength * 7) * carVisualScale;
                    let alpha = Math.min(0.85, cc.strength * 0.9) * ramp;
                    if (alpha <= 0.01) continue;
                    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
                    setLocalTransform(target.x + cc.ux * offsetLen, ty + cc.uy * offsetLen, ca, sa, vs);
                    if (tImg) {
                        drawCarCell(ctx, shadowCarImg, imgCarLevel);
                    } else if (vec) {
                        drawCarCell(ctx, vec.dynShadowFill, vecCarLevel);
                        drawCarCell(ctx, vec.dynShadowStroke, vecCarLevel);
                    } else {
                        drawCarShadowSilhouette(ctx, target);
                    }
                }
            }
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
            resetToBaseTransform();
        }

        function drawLitCars(pass) {
            if (g_lightK <= 0.02 || !beamSprite || g_lightSources.length === 0) return;
            const half = (LIT_S / 2) / LIT_K;
            const maxRange = BEAM_LEN + 20;
            const dw = beamSprite.width / BEAM_SCALE;
            const dh = beamSprite.height / BEAM_SCALE;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
            ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, g_lightK * 1.5);

            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                let target = cars[i];
                if (target.state === 'dead') continue;
                if (pass === 1 && isLifted(target)) continue;
                if (pass === 2 && !isLifted(target)) continue;
                if (!inView(target.x, target.y, half)) continue;

                litSrcTmp.length = 0;
                const ty = target.y;

                for (let j = 0; j < g_lightSources.length; j++) {
                    let src = g_lightSources[j];
                    if (src.car === target) continue;
                    let dx = target.x - src.x, dy = ty - src.y;
                    let d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
                    if (d < 3 || d > maxRange) continue;
                    let dot = (dx * src.ca + dy * src.sa) / d;
                    let edge = coneEdge(dot);
                    if (edge <= 0) continue;
                    let strength = (1 - d / maxRange) * src.int * edge;
                    if (strength <= 0.03) continue;
                    litSrcTmp.push(src);
                }
                if (litSrcTmp.length === 0) continue;

                // This car's slot; the cars' light is built up in separate slots
                // and all of them are drawn from the same buffer.
                const slot = litSlot++ % LIT_SLOTS;
                const sx = (slot % LIT_COLS) * LIT_S;
                const sy = Math.floor(slot / LIT_COLS) * LIT_S;
                // Maps logical coords to the slot, centered on the target.
                const ox = sx + LIT_S / 2 - target.x * LIT_K;
                const oy = sy + LIT_S / 2 - ty * LIT_K;

                litCtx.save();
                litCtx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
                // The clip keeps the composite modes below (which affect everything
                // outside what they draw) inside this slot.
                litCtx.beginPath();
                litCtx.rect(sx, sy, LIT_S, LIT_S);
                litCtx.clip();
                litCtx.clearRect(sx, sy, LIT_S, LIT_S);
                litCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                const bk = LIT_K * carVisualScale;
                for (let j = 0; j < litSrcTmp.length; j++) {
                    let src = litSrcTmp[j];
                    litCtx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, src.int * 1.35);
                    litCtx.setTransform(src.ca * bk, src.sa * bk, -src.sa * bk, src.ca * bk,
                        ox + src.x * LIT_K, oy + src.y * LIT_K);
                    litCtx.drawImage(beamSprite, -beamSpriteOX, -beamSpriteOY, dw, dh);
                }

                litCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
                litCtx.globalAlpha = 1;
                const tAng = target.angle + target.driftAngle;
                const vs = (target.isFireTruck ? 1 : carVisualScale) * (1 + (target.liftF || 0) * LIFT_SCALE);
                const tk = LIT_K * vs, tc = Math.cos(tAng), ts = Math.sin(tAng);
                litCtx.setTransform(tc * tk, ts * tk, -ts * tk, tc * tk, ox + target.x * LIT_K, oy + ty * LIT_K);
                if (!target.isFireTruck && carImageLoaded && preRenderedCars[target.color]) {
                    drawCarCell(litCtx, preRenderedCars[target.color], carMipLevel(carImgScale, tk));
                } else {
                    litCtx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                    litCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
                    litCtx.lineWidth = 6;
                    litCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
                    const pts = carOutline(target);
                    litCtx.beginPath();
                    for (let p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                        let px = pts[p].x + target.damage[p].x;
                        let py = pts[p].y + target.damage[p].y;
                        if (p === 0) litCtx.moveTo(px, py);
                        else litCtx.lineTo(px, py);
                    }
                    litCtx.closePath();
                    litCtx.fill();
                    litCtx.stroke();
                }
                litCtx.restore();

                ctx.drawImage(litCanvas, sx, sy, LIT_S, LIT_S, target.x - half, ty - half, LIT_S / LIT_K, LIT_S / LIT_K);
            }
            ctx.restore();
        }

        function drawParticleList(pList, isFading) {
            for (let i = 0; i < pList.length; i++) {
                let p = pList[i];
                if (!isFading && !p.active) continue;
                
                let alpha;
                if (isFading) {
                    alpha = Math.max(0, (p.fadeTimer / 0.3) * p.life * 0.95);
                } else {
                    alpha = Math.max(0, p.life * 0.95);
                }
                if (alpha <= 0) continue;
                if (!inView(p.x, p.y, p.size * 2)) continue;
                
                // One setTransform instead of save/translate/rotate/restore.
                ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
                ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
                setLocalTransform(p.x, p.y, Math.cos(p.angle), Math.sin(p.angle), 1);
                ctx.beginPath();
                if (p.type === 'firework') {
                    ctx.moveTo(0, -p.size);
                    ctx.lineTo(p.size, 0);
                    ctx.lineTo(0, p.size);
                    ctx.lineTo(-p.size, 0);
                } else {
                    ctx.moveTo(0, -p.size);
                    ctx.lineTo(p.size * 0.866, p.size * 0.5);
                    ctx.lineTo(-p.size * 0.866, p.size * 0.5);
                }
                ctx.closePath();
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        // A car merging onto the track gets a soft glow in its color and a
        // ring that expands and fades, both following it, screen-blended under
        // the cars (two draws per car, inside drawParticles' blend mode). Police
        // cars, fire trucks and the cars they turn green get a bigger, brighter
        // ring (mergeFxStrong) that also lasts twice as long.
        const MERGE_FX_TIME = 0.45;
        function mergeFxTime(car) {
            return car.mergeFxStrong ? MERGE_FX_TIME : MERGE_FX_TIME / 2;
        }
        // Per color: a small glow sprite (a soft gradient, so 64px drawn bigger
        // looks the same as a large one) and the ring color.
        const mergeFxColors = {};
        function getMergeFx(color) {
            let fx = mergeFxColors[color];
            if (!fx) {
                const c = hexToRgb(color);
                const glow = document.createElement('canvas');
                glow.width = glow.height = 64;
                const g = glow.getContext('2d');
                const grad = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
                grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${c.r}, ${c.g}, ${c.b}, 1)`);
                grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${c.r}, ${c.g}, ${c.b}, 0)`);
                g.fillStyle = grad;
                g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
                const w = (v) => Math.round(v + (255 - v) * 0.5);
                fx = mergeFxColors[color] = { glow, ring: `rgb(${w(c.r)}, ${w(c.g)}, ${w(c.b)})` };
            }
            return fx;
        }

        function drawMergeEffects() {
            let first = true;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                const car = cars[i];
                if (car.mergeFxT < 0 || car.state === 'dead' || !inView(car.x, car.y, 60)) continue;
                if (first) {
                    resetToBaseTransform();
                    first = false;
                }
                const fx = getMergeFx(car.color);
                const u = Math.min(1, car.mergeFxT / mergeFxTime(car));
                const e = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u) * (1 - u);   // ease-out
                const g = 30 + 18 * e;
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 * (1 - u);
                ctx.drawImage(fx.glow, car.x - g, car.y - g, g * 2, g * 2);
                const strong = car.mergeFxStrong;
                ctx.globalAlpha = (strong ? 0.9 : 0.55) * (1 - u);
                ctx.strokeStyle = fx.ring;
                ctx.lineWidth = 0.5 + (strong ? 4.5 : 3) * (1 - u);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(car.x, car.y, strong ? 14 + 34 * e : 12 + 20 * e, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
        }

        function drawParticles() {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
            drawParticleList(fadingParticles, true);
            drawParticleList(particlePool, false);
            drawMergeEffects();
            ctx.restore();
        }

        const glowSprites = {};
        function getGlowSprite(coreColor) {
            let s = glowSprites[coreColor];
            if (!s) {
                s = document.createElement('canvas');
                s.width = 240; s.height = 240;
                const g = s.getContext('2d');
                const grad = g.createRadialGradient(120, 120, 0, 120, 120, 120);
                grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${coreColor}, 1)`);
                grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${coreColor}, 0)`);
                g.fillStyle = grad;
                g.fillRect(0, 0, 240, 240);
                glowSprites[coreColor] = s;
            }
            return s;
        }

        // The level number and crown only change with the level and state, so
        // they're drawn once into a sprite and blended with the pulsing alpha,
        // instead of rasterizing huge glyphs every frame (at this size browsers
        // fill them as paths, especially when zoomed in). The sprite is placed
        // on whole device pixels at rest, so it stays as crisp as before.
        const LEVEL_FONT = 'bold 80px "Segoe UI", Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif';
        const levelSprites = [0, 1].map(() => ({ key: '', canvas: document.createElement('canvas'), x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0 }));
        function getLevelSprite(zoomed, coreColor, crown) {
            const spr = levelSprites[zoomed ? 1 : 0];
            const key = level + '|' + coreColor + '|' + crown + '|' + globalScale + '|' + cx + '|' + cy + '|' + gameHeight;
            if (spr.key === key) return spr;
            spr.key = key;
            // The camera it's drawn 1:1 for: at rest, or fully zoomed in.
            const z = zoomed ? CAM_ZOOM_IN : 1;
            const pan = zoomed ? -gameHeight * 0.33 : 0;
            const s = globalScale * z;
            const g = spr.canvas.getContext('2d');
            g.font = LEVEL_FONT;
            const hw = Math.max(g.measureText(String(level)).width / 2, 27) + 6;
            const devX = Math.floor(globalScale * (z * (cx - hw) + cx * (1 - z)));
            const devY = Math.floor(globalScale * (z * (cy - 96) + cy * (1 - z) + pan));
            spr.x = (devX / globalScale - cx * (1 - z)) / z;
            spr.y = (devY / globalScale - cy * (1 - z) - pan) / z;
            const wPx = Math.ceil((cx + hw - spr.x) * s) + 1;
            const hPx = Math.ceil((cy + 52 - spr.y) * s) + 1;
            spr.canvas.width = wPx;   // (also resets the context state)
            spr.canvas.height = hPx;
            spr.w = wPx / s;
            spr.h = hPx / s;
            g.setTransform(s, 0, 0, s, -spr.x * s, -spr.y * s);
            if (crown) {
                g.fillStyle = 'rgb(255, 215, 0)';
                drawCrownShape(g, cx, cy - 64, 46);
            }
            g.font = LEVEL_FONT;
            g.textAlign = 'center';
            g.textBaseline = 'middle';
            g.fillStyle = `rgb(${coreColor})`;
            g.fillText(level, cx, cy);
            return spr;
        }

        function drawLevelNumber() {
            if (!isFinite(cx) || !isFinite(cy)) return;

            // Text and crown share the same alpha in every state.
            let alpha = 0.15;
            let coreColor = '255, 255, 255';
            
            if (state === 'menu') {
                alpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(pulseTime * 3) * 0.2;
            } else if (state === 'gameover' || state === 'levelcomplete') {
                alpha = 0.6 + Math.sin(pulseTime * 5) * 0.4;
                coreColor = state === 'gameover' ? `255, 71, 87` : `46, 213, 115`;
                
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, alpha * 0.7));
                ctx.drawImage(getGlowSprite(coreColor), cx - 120, cy - 120, 240, 240);
                ctx.restore();
            }

            const spr = getLevelSprite(camZoom >= ZOOM_LAYER_MIN, coreColor, getPendingUnlockCar(level) !== null);
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, alpha));
            ctx.drawImage(spr.canvas, spr.x, spr.y, spr.w, spr.h);
            ctx.restore();
        }

        function draw() {
            ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            litSlot = 0;

            viewMinX = cx - cx / camZoom;
            viewMaxX = cx + cx / camZoom;
            viewMinY = (cy * (camZoom - 1) - camPan) / camZoom;
            viewMaxY = (gameHeight + cy * (camZoom - 1) - camPan) / camZoom;

            const carScreenPx = globalScale * camZoom * carVisualScale;
            imgCarLevel = carMipLevel(carImgScale, carScreenPx);
            vecCarLevel = vectorCarSet ? carMipLevel(vectorCarSet.scale, carScreenPx) : 0;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.scale(globalScale, globalScale);

            ctx.translate(cx * (1 - camZoom), cy * (1 - camZoom) + camPan);
            ctx.scale(camZoom, camZoom);

            ctx.save();
            if (isReversed) {
                ctx.translate(cx, 0);
                ctx.scale(-1, 1);
                ctx.translate(-cx, 0);
            }
            captureBaseTransform();

            drawTrackLayers();

            drawParticles();
            prepareLighting();
            drawDynamicShadows();

            if (currentTrack.opInfo) {
                drawTrails(1);
                drawCars(1);
                drawLitCars(1);
                drawHeadlightBeams(1);
                
                drawOverpass();
                
                drawTrails(2);
                drawCars(2);
                drawLitCars(2);
                drawHeadlightBeams(2);
            } else {
                drawTrails(0);
                drawCars(0);
                drawLitCars(0);
                drawHeadlightBeams(0);
            }
            ctx.restore();

            drawLevelNumber();
            
            ctx.restore(); 
        }

        // Low-FPS detection compares against the best rate this device has
        // managed, so a 30 Hz cap (battery saver / low power mode) isn't taken
        // for lag, and it ignores the loading period and stalls such as a
        // hidden tab.
        let peakFps = 0;
        let loopStartTime = -1;

        function loop(timestamp) {
            let dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000;
            if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;
            lastTime = timestamp;
            if (loopStartTime < 0) {
                loopStartTime = timestamp;
                lastFpsTime = timestamp;
            }

            frames++;
            const fpsWindow = timestamp - lastFpsTime;
            if (fpsWindow >= 1000) {
                if (fpsWindow < 2000 && timestamp - loopStartTime > 2500) {
                    const fps = frames * 1000 / fpsWindow;
                    if (fps > peakFps) peakFps = fps;
                    const lowFps = fps < Math.min(50, peakFps * 0.83);
                    const lightingMode = skinMenuOpen || camZoom > 1.02;
                    if (lightingMode) {
                        if (lowFps && lightingEnabled) {
                            lowLightFpsSeconds++;
                            if (lowLightFpsSeconds >= 2) {
                                lightingEnabled = false;
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (lowFps) {
                            lowFpsSeconds++;
                            if (lowFpsSeconds >= 5 && showTrails) {
                                showTrails = false;
                            }
                        } else {
                            lowFpsSeconds = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
                frames = 0;
                lastFpsTime = timestamp;
            }

            try {
                update(dt);
                // The reward screen is opaque, so skip drawing the game behind it.
                if (!rewardOverlayVisible) draw();
                updateSkinUI();
                updateAudioUI();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error(e);
            }
            requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }

        function seededRandom(seed) {
            let x = Math.sin(seed) * 10000;
            return x - Math.floor(x);
        }

        // Shows the cue-tip text underneath the top action button.
        // - Skip button: always shown (no tooltip needed for it).
        // - Slow-down button: shown only once the player has failed 10+ times.
        function updateTopActionLabel() {
            if (!topActionLabel) return;
            if (topButtonState === 'hidden') {
                topActionLabel.style.display = 'none';
                return;
            }
            if (topButtonState === 'skip') {
                topActionLabel.textContent = getTranslation('skip').toUpperCase();
                topActionLabel.style.display = 'block';
            } else if (topButtonState === 'slow') {
                if ((levelLosses[level] || 0) >= 10) {
                    topActionLabel.textContent = getTranslation('slow').toUpperCase();
                    topActionLabel.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    topActionLabel.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }
        }

        let lastSlowVisibleLevel = -1;
        function updateTopButtonDisplay() {
            if (level <= 5) {
                topButtonState = 'hidden';
                topActionBtn.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                if (level === lastPlayedLevelForButton && topButtonState === 'skip') {
                    topActionBtn.innerHTML = skipImgHTML;
                    topActionBtn.title = ''; // skip: text always shown beneath, no cue tip
                    topActionBtn.style.display = 'flex';
                } else {
                    topButtonState = 'slow';
                    topActionBtn.innerHTML = snailImgHTML;
                    topActionBtn.title = getTranslation('slow').toUpperCase();
                    topActionBtn.style.display = 'flex';
                    if (lastSlowVisibleLevel !== level) {
                        lastSlowVisibleLevel = level;
                        track('button', 'slow-down-' + level, 'visible');
                    }
                }
            }
            updateTopActionLabel();
            updateSkipAdButton();
        }

        function loadLevelFromString(str, autoStart, showAd = false) {
            try {
                isPreloaded = true;
                isWaveLevel = false;
                const parts = str.split('|');
                let shapeIdx = parseInt(parts[1]);
                let pattern = parts[2];
                isReversed = parts[3] === '1';
                let trackColorsIdx = parts[4] ? parts[4].split(',') : [];
                let queueColorsIdx = parts[5] ? parts[5].split(',') : [];
                trackSpeed = parseInt(parts[6]);
                let explicitPaletteId = parts[7] !== undefined ? parts[7].trim() : '';

                trackSpeed = Math.max(170, Math.min(250, trackSpeed));

                selectTrack(allTrackDefs[shapeIdx] || trackLayouts[0]);
                updateScale();

                if (devPaletteOverride !== null) {
                    activePaletteColors = getPaletteColorsById(devPaletteOverride) || standardColors;
                } else if (explicitPaletteId !== '' && getPaletteColorsById(explicitPaletteId)) {
                    activePaletteColors = getPaletteColorsById(explicitPaletteId);
                } else {
                    activePaletteColors = pickPaletteForLevel(level);
                }

                let trackColors = trackColorsIdx.map(i => resolvePaletteColorIndex(parseInt(i), activePaletteColors));
                let queueColors = queueColorsIdx.map(i => resolvePaletteColorIndex(parseInt(i), activePaletteColors));

                hasExitRoad = [...trackColors, ...queueColors].some(c => c === exitColor || c === policeColor || c === fireTruckColor);

                fadingCars = cars.filter(c => c.state === 'crashed').map(c => ({...c, fadeTimer: 0.3}));
                fadingParticles = particlePool.filter(p => p.active && p.type !== 'firework').map(p => ({...p, fadeTimer: 0.3}));

                cars = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < particlePool.length; i++) particlePool[i].active = false;
                particleCursor = 0;
                carIdCounter = 0;

                let offset = currentTrack.perimeter / 2;
                let initialCars = trackColors.length;
                activeCarsOnTrack = initialCars;

                for (let i = 0; i < initialCars; i++) {
                    let initDist = 0;
                    let spacing = 55; 
                    if (pattern === 'even') {
                        initDist = i * (currentTrack.perimeter / initialCars);
                    } else if (pattern === '2_clusters') {
                        let clusterIdx = Math.floor(i / (initialCars / 2));
                        let inClusterIdx = i % (initialCars / 2);
                        initDist = clusterIdx * (currentTrack.perimeter / 2) + inClusterIdx * spacing;
                    } else if (pattern === '3_clusters') {
                        let clusterIdx = Math.floor(i / (initialCars / 3));
                        let inClusterIdx = i % (initialCars / 3);
                        initDist = clusterIdx * (currentTrack.perimeter / 3) + inClusterIdx * spacing;
                    } else if (pattern === '4_clusters') {
                        let clusterIdx = Math.floor(i / (initialCars / 4));
                        let inClusterIdx = i % (initialCars / 4);
                        initDist = clusterIdx * (currentTrack.perimeter / 4) + inClusterIdx * spacing;
                    }
                    initDist = (initDist + offset) % currentTrack.perimeter;

                    let car = createCarObj('track', trackColors[i]);
                    car.distance = initDist;
                    updateTrackPosition(car, initDist);
                    car.liftF = computeLiftF(initDist);
                    car.driftAngle = car.isCurve ? 0.25 * (car.curveDir || 1) : 0;
                    car.steerAngle = car.isCurve ? 0.4 * (car.curveDir || 1) : 0;
                    cars.push(car);
                }

                const mergeY = cy + currentTrack.bottomOff;
                for (let i = 0; i < queueColors.length; i++) {
                    let car = createCarObj('queue', queueColors[i]);
                    car.indexInQueue = i;
                    car.x = cx + entryRadius;
                    car.y = gameHeight + 100;
                    car.targetY = mergeY + entryRadius + 15 + i * 45;
                    car.angle = -Math.PI/2;
                    cars.push(car);
                }

                applyDifficultyReductions();

                updateTopButtonDisplay();
                if (topButtonState === 'skip') {
                    trackSpeed *= 0.7;
                    for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                        if (cars[i].state === 'track') cars[i].actualSpeed = trackSpeed;
                    }
                }

                if (autoStart) {
                    if (showAd) {
                        triggerCommercialBreak(() => {
                            state = 'playing';
                            pokiGameplayStart();
                        });
                    } else {
                        state = 'playing';
                        pokiGameplayStart();
                    }
                } else {
                    state = 'menu';
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Failed to load level from string", e);
                generateProceduralLevel(level, autoStart, showAd);
            }
        }

        function generateProceduralLevel(lvl, autoStart, showAd = false) {
            isPreloaded = false;
            
            let chosen = pickTrackForLevel(lvl);
            let rawDirection = seededRandom(lvl * 1.1) > 0.5;
            
            if (lvl > 1) {
                let prevLvl = lvl - 1;
                if (pickTrackForLevel(prevLvl) === chosen) {
                    let prevDirection = seededRandom(prevLvl * 1.1) > 0.5;
                    isReversed = !prevDirection;
                } else {
                    isReversed = rawDirection;
                }
            } else {
                isReversed = rawDirection;
            }

            selectTrack(chosen);
            updateScale();

            activePaletteColors = devPaletteOverride !== null
                ? (getPaletteColorsById(devPaletteOverride) || standardColors)
                : pickPaletteForLevel(lvl);

            let densityFactor = seededRandom(lvl * 3.3);
            
            // Speed rises steadily with the level: halfway between the level's
            // min and max speed, with no random ups and downs between levels.
            let minSpeed = 130 + Math.min(lvl * 1.5, 120); 
            let maxSpeed = (180 + Math.min(lvl * 2.5, 150)) * 0.9;
            
            trackSpeed = (minSpeed + maxSpeed) / 2;
            trackSpeed = Math.max(200, Math.min(250, trackSpeed));

            let minCars = 4 + Math.floor(lvl / 5);
            let maxCarsForLevel = 6 + Math.floor(lvl / 2.5);
            let desiredTotalCars = Math.floor(minCars + densityFactor * (maxCarsForLevel - minCars));

            let absoluteMaxCars = Math.max(9, Math.floor(currentTrack.perimeter / 55)) + (currentTrack.maxCarsOffset || 0);
            let totalCars = Math.min(desiredTotalCars, absoluteMaxCars);

            isWaveLevel = (lvl > 20 && seededRandom(lvl * 9.9) < 0.10);
            // Fire truck levels: after level 100, never on clover or tracks with
            // an overpass (those hold a lot more cars), and never a wave level.
            const isFireLevel = !isWaveLevel && lvl > 100 && chosen !== cloverTrack &&
                !(chosen.opInfos || []).length && seededRandom(lvl * 6.1) < 0.10;

            let splitFactor = seededRandom(lvl * 4.4);
            let initialCars = Math.max(4, Math.floor(splitFactor * (totalCars - 5)));
            // A fire level starts nearly empty, for a long build-up.
            if (isFireLevel) initialCars = 4;
            
            let patterns = ['even', '3_clusters', '4_clusters'];
            let patternIdx = Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl * 5.5) * patterns.length);
            let pattern = patterns[patternIdx];

            if (pattern === '3_clusters') {
                initialCars = Math.max(6, Math.round(initialCars / 3) * 3);
            } else if (pattern === '4_clusters') {
                initialCars = Math.max(4, Math.round(initialCars / 4) * 4);
            } else if (pattern === 'even') {
                initialCars = Math.min(initialCars, 8); 
            }
            
            targetCars = Math.max(5, totalCars - initialCars);
            totalCars = initialCars + targetCars;
            activeCarsOnTrack = initialCars;

            let offset = currentTrack.perimeter / 2; 

            fadingCars = cars.filter(c => c.state === 'crashed').map(c => ({...c, fadeTimer: 0.3}));
            fadingParticles = particlePool.filter(p => p.active && p.type !== 'firework').map(p => ({...p, fadeTimer: 0.3}));

            cars = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < particlePool.length; i++) particlePool[i].active = false;
            particleCursor = 0;
            carIdCounter = 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < initialCars; i++) {
                let initDist = 0;
                let spacing = 55; 
                
                if (pattern === 'even') {
                    initDist = i * (currentTrack.perimeter / initialCars);
                } else if (pattern === '3_clusters') {
                    let clusterIdx = Math.floor(i / (initialCars / 3));
                    let inClusterIdx = i % (initialCars / 3);
                    initDist = clusterIdx * (currentTrack.perimeter / 3) + inClusterIdx * spacing;
                } else if (pattern === '4_clusters') {
                    let clusterIdx = Math.floor(i / (initialCars / 4));
                    let inClusterIdx = i % (initialCars / 4);
                    initDist = clusterIdx * (currentTrack.perimeter / 4) + inClusterIdx * spacing;
                }

                initDist = (initDist + offset) % currentTrack.perimeter;

                let car = createCarObj('track', activePaletteColors[i % activePaletteColors.length]);
                car.distance = initDist;
                updateTrackPosition(car, initDist);
                car.liftF = computeLiftF(initDist);
                car.driftAngle = car.isCurve ? 0.25 * (car.curveDir || 1) : 0;
                car.steerAngle = car.isCurve ? 0.4 * (car.curveDir || 1) : 0;
                cars.push(car);
            }

            let queueColors = [];

            if (isWaveLevel) {
                // Every car gets taken out in the end: remTakeOut counts the cars
                // still to go (a police car takes out 1, a fire truck 2).
                hasExitRoad = true; 
                
                let currentTrackCars = initialCars;
                let remRegular = targetCars;
                let remTakeOut = initialCars + targetCars;
                let loopCounter = 0;

                while (remRegular > 0 || remTakeOut > 0) {
                    loopCounter++;
                    let spaceLeft = absoluteMaxCars - currentTrackCars;
                    
                    let rToAdd = 0;
                    if (remRegular > 0) {
                        let maxR = Math.min(remRegular, Math.max(1, spaceLeft));
                        rToAdd = Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl * 100 + loopCounter) * maxR) + 1;
                        if (rToAdd > remRegular) rToAdd = remRegular;
                        
                        for(let i=0; i<rToAdd; i++) {
                            queueColors.push(activePaletteColors[Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl*10+remRegular+i) * activePaletteColors.length)]);
                        }
                        remRegular -= rToAdd;
                        currentTrackCars += rToAdd;
                    }

                    let takeOut = 0;
                    if (remRegular === 0) {
                        takeOut = remTakeOut;
                    } else if (remTakeOut > 0) {
                        let maxP = Math.min(remTakeOut, Math.max(1, rToAdd)); 
                        takeOut = Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl * 200 + loopCounter) * maxP) + 1;
                        if (currentTrackCars - takeOut < 3) {
                            takeOut = Math.max(0, currentTrackCars - 3);
                        }
                    }

                    // After level 50 some of them are fire trucks (only when at
                    // least 2 cars are left to take out, as a truck takes out 2).
                    let left = takeOut;
                    while (left > 0) {
                        if (lvl > 50 && left >= 2 && seededRandom(lvl * 300 + queueColors.length) < 0.4) {
                            queueColors.push(fireTruckColor);
                            left -= 2;
                        } else {
                            queueColors.push(policeColor);
                            left--;
                        }
                    }
                    remTakeOut -= takeOut;
                    currentTrackCars -= takeOut;
                }
            } else if (isFireLevel) {
                // Build-up: regular cars until the track holds its max. Release:
                // 3-4 fire trucks back to back, taking out 6-8 cars. Finish: more
                // cars, refilling most (never all) of what was cleared.
                hasExitRoad = true;
                const buildUp = Math.max(0, absoluteMaxCars - initialCars);
                const numTrucks = 3 + Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl * 7.3) * 2);
                const finish = numTrucks + 1 + Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl * 8.1) * (numTrucks - 1));
                targetCars = buildUp + finish;
                for (let i = 0; i < targetCars; i++) {
                    if (i === buildUp) for (let k = 0; k < numTrucks; k++) queueColors.push(fireTruckColor);
                    queueColors.push(activePaletteColors[Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl*10+i) * activePaletteColors.length)]);
                }
            } else {
                let numExit = (lvl > 10 && seededRandom(lvl * 7.7) > 0.5) ? Math.floor(targetCars / 3) + 1 : 0;
                let numPolice = (lvl > 15 && seededRandom(lvl * 8.8) > 0.3) ? Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl * 3.1) * 3) + 1 : 0;
                // Fire trucks: after level 50, 2.5x rarer than police cars.
                let numFire = (lvl > 50 && seededRandom(lvl * 12.7) < 0.28) ? Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl * 2.9) * 3) + 1 : 0;
                // 80% of those levels have just 1 or 2 fire trucks and no police.
                if (numFire > 0 && seededRandom(lvl * 4.7) < 0.8) {
                    numPolice = 0;
                    numFire = Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl * 2.9) * 2) + 1;
                }
                hasExitRoad = numExit > 0 || numPolice > 0 || numFire > 0;
                
                for(let i=0; i<targetCars; i++) {
                    queueColors.push(activePaletteColors[Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl*10+i) * activePaletteColors.length)]);
                }
                for(let i=0; i<numExit; i++) queueColors.push(exitColor);
                for(let i=0; i<numPolice; i++) queueColors.push(policeColor);
                for(let i=0; i<numFire; i++) queueColors.push(fireTruckColor);
                
                for (let i = queueColors.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                    let j = Math.floor(seededRandom(lvl * 20 + i) * (i + 1));
                    [queueColors[i], queueColors[j]] = [queueColors[j], queueColors[i]];
                }

                const isSpecial = c => c === exitColor || c === policeColor || c === fireTruckColor;
                if (isSpecial(queueColors[queueColors.length - 1])) {
                    let swapIdx = queueColors.findIndex(c => !isSpecial(c));
                    if (swapIdx !== -1) {
                        let temp = queueColors[queueColors.length - 1];
                        queueColors[queueColors.length - 1] = queueColors[swapIdx];
                        queueColors[swapIdx] = temp;
                    }
                }
            }

            const mergeY = cy + currentTrack.bottomOff;
            for (let i = 0; i < queueColors.length; i++) {
                let car = createCarObj('queue', queueColors[i]);
                car.indexInQueue = i;
                car.x = cx + entryRadius;
                car.y = gameHeight + 100;
                car.targetY = mergeY + entryRadius + 15 + i * 45;
                car.angle = -Math.PI/2;
                cars.push(car);
            }

            applyDifficultyReductions();

            updateTopButtonDisplay();
            if (topButtonState === 'skip') {
                trackSpeed *= 0.7;
                for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                    if (cars[i].state === 'track') cars[i].actualSpeed = trackSpeed;
                }
            }
            
            if (autoStart) {
                if (showAd) {
                    triggerCommercialBreak(() => {
                        state = 'playing';
                        pokiGameplayStart();
                    });
                } else {
                    state = 'playing';
                    pokiGameplayStart();
                }
            } else {
                state = 'menu';
            }
        }

        // Advances every freshly (re)spawned track car by `elapsed` seconds of
        // constant-speed travel, so a restart doesn't snap the whole field back
        // to its level-start formation. All track cars share the same speed, so
        // their relative spacing (and thus safety) is preserved exactly.
        function fastForwardTrackCars(elapsed) {
            if (!(elapsed > 0) || !currentTrack) return;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                let car = cars[i];
                if (car.state !== 'track') continue;
                car.distance = (car.distance + trackSpeed * elapsed) % currentTrack.perimeter;
                updateTrackPosition(car, car.distance);
                car.liftF = computeLiftF(car.distance);
                car.driftAngle = car.isCurve ? 0.25 * (car.curveDir || 1) : 0;
                car.steerAngle = car.isCurve ? 0.4 * (car.curveDir || 1) : 0;
            }
        }

        function setupLevel(lvl, autoStart = true, showAd = false, isRestart = false) {
            level = lvl;
            carsAdded = 0;
            launchCooldown = 0;
            bufferedLaunches = 0;
            hasLaunchedThisLevel = false;
            levelCompleteTimer = 0;
            endSoundPlayed = false;
            finishCarsList = [];
            lastCarEntered = null;
            restartDriveRate = 0;
            safeFirstLaunch = isRestart;
            pendingLaunchTimer = -1;
            saveLevel(level);

            // A restart keeps the level clock running (it never stopped ticking
            // through the gameover screen) so the fast-forward below lines the
            // fresh cars back up with real elapsed time. A genuinely new level
            // attempt starts the clock over.
            if (!isRestart) levelElapsedTime = 0;

            skinMenuOpen = false;
            skinExpanded = !isRestart;
            // The sound button is full size only on the first level it shows
            // on (from level 2); every later level (and restart) starts with
            // it as a small circle.
            audioExpanded = !audioStartShown;
            if (lvl >= 2) audioStartShown = true;

            if (camFlourishTimeout) { clearTimeout(camFlourishTimeout); camFlourishTimeout = null; }
            camZoomTarget = 1;
            camPanTarget = 0;

            markPassedCarsOffered();
            // (The skin tiles are re-rendered whenever the menu opens.)

            if (preloadedLevels[lvl]) {
                loadLevelFromString(preloadedLevels[lvl], autoStart, showAd);
            } else {
                generateProceduralLevel(lvl, autoStart, showAd);
            }

            if (isRestart) {
                fastForwardTrackCars(levelElapsedTime);
                // The queue drives up again, sped up if it would take longer
                // than RESTART_DRIVE_UP (the front car is in place once it's
                // within 5px, which takes ln(distance / 5) / rate seconds).
                const front = frontQueueCar();
                const dist = front ? Math.abs(front.y - front.targetY) : 0;
                const rate = dist > 5 ? Math.log(dist / 5) / RESTART_DRIVE_UP : 0;
                if (rate > 8) restartDriveRate = rate;
            }

            invalidateTrackLayers();

            if (lvl === 1 || lvl === 5) {
                const dur = lvl === 1 ? '0.5s' : '0.26s';
                tutorialHint.style.display = 'block';
                tutorialHint.style.setProperty('--anim-duration', dur);
                tutorialHint.classList.toggle('pos-left', lvl === 5);

                if (!isLikelyTouchDevice()) {
                    tutorialArrows.style.display = 'block';
                    tutorialArrows.style.setProperty('--anim-duration', dur);
                    tutorialArrows.classList.toggle('pos-left', lvl === 1);
                    tutorialArrows.classList.toggle('pos-right', lvl === 5);
                } else {
                    tutorialArrows.style.display = 'none';
                }
            } else {
                tutorialHint.style.display = 'none';
                tutorialHint.classList.remove('pos-left');
                tutorialArrows.style.display = 'none';
            }
            
            lastPlayedLevelForButton = level;
        }

        function handleInput(e) {
            if (isAdPlaying) return;
            
            if (e.type === 'touchstart') {
                isTouchDevice = true;
            } else if (e.type === 'mousedown' && isTouchDevice) {
                return;
            }

            if (state === 'carreward') return;

            if (skinMenuOpen) {
                closeSkinMenu();
                return;
            }

            if (e.type === 'keydown' && e.code !== 'Space' && e.code !== 'ArrowUp' && e.code !== 'KeyW') return;
            if (e.type === 'keydown') e.preventDefault();

            if (state === 'menu') {
                triggerCommercialBreak(() => {
                    state = 'playing';
                    pokiGameplayStart();
                });
                return;
            }

            if (state === 'gameover') {
                setupLevel(level, true, false, true);
                return;
            }

            if (state === 'levelcomplete') {
                if (levelCompleteTimer > 0.1) {
                    proceedToNextLevel();
                }
                return;
            }

            if (state === 'playing') {
                if (!hasLaunchedThisLevel) {
                    let firstQueueCar = null;
                    let minIdx = Infinity;
                    for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                        if (cars[i].state === 'queue' && cars[i].indexInQueue < minIdx) {
                            minIdx = cars[i].indexInQueue;
                            firstQueueCar = cars[i];
                        }
                    }
                    if (firstQueueCar && Math.abs(firstQueueCar.y - firstQueueCar.targetY) > 5) {
                        return; 
                    }
                    if (safeFirstLaunch && firstQueueCar) {
                        if (pendingLaunchTimer >= 0) return;
                        if (launchIsSafe(firstQueueCar, 0)) {
                            launchCar();
                            return;
                        }
                        // Hold the launch for the next gap (it must stay open for
                        // at least a frame), or ignore the tap if none comes soon.
                        const step = 1 / 120;
                        for (let d = step; d <= SAFE_LAUNCH_WINDOW + 1e-9; d += step) {
                            if (launchIsSafe(firstQueueCar, d) && launchIsSafe(firstQueueCar, d + 1 / 60)) {
                                pendingLaunchTimer = SAFE_LAUNCH_WINDOW + 1 / 30;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (launchCooldown <= 0) {
                    if (!launchCar()) {
                        bufferedLaunches = 0; 
                    }
                } else {
                    bufferedLaunches++;
                }
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener('mousedown', handleInput);
        // Passive: handleInput never cancels a touch (CSS touch-action already
        // stops scrolling/zooming). A non-passive touch listener makes the
        // browser wait for this thread before it can handle each touch, which
        // on iOS shows up as a small hitch on every tap.
        window.addEventListener('touchstart', handleInput, {passive: true});
        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleInput);

        let devDHeld = false;
        window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.code === 'KeyD') devDHeld = true;
            if (devDHeld && (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'ArrowRight')) {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (isAdPlaying) return;
                const nl = e.code === 'ArrowLeft' ? Math.max(1, level - 1) : level + 1;
                if (rewardParticleAnim) { cancelAnimationFrame(rewardParticleAnim); rewardParticleAnim = null; }
                rewardCarId = -1;
                hideCarRewardScreen();
                setupLevel(nl, false, false);
            }
            // Debug: hold D + a digit key to force that palette id (0 = default)
            // on the current level, regardless of what it would normally pick.
            if (devDHeld && /^Digit[0-9]$/.test(e.code)) {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (isAdPlaying) return;
                const id = e.code.slice(5);
                if (getPaletteColorsById(id)) {
                    devPaletteOverride = id;
                    setupLevel(level, false, false);
                }
            }
        });
        window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            if (e.code === 'KeyD') devDHeld = false;
        });
        window.addEventListener('blur', () => { devDHeld = false; });

        function handleTopAction() {
            if (isAdPlaying) return;
            clearGlow(); 
            if (topButtonState === 'slow') {
                // Slow-down uses a SMALL rewarded ad.
                track('button', 'slow-down-' + level, 'interact');
                playRewardedAd((success) => {
                    if (success) applySlowDown();
                }, 'small');
            } else if (topButtonState === 'skip') {
                track('button', 'skip-level-' + level, 'interact');
                pokiGameplayStop();
                proceedToNextLevel();
            }
        }
        
        function applySlowDown() {
            trackSpeed *= 0.7;
            for (let i = 0; i < cars.length; i++) {
                if (cars[i].state === 'track') {
                    cars[i].actualSpeed = trackSpeed;
                }
            }
            topButtonState = 'skip';
            topActionBtn.innerHTML = skipImgHTML;
            topActionBtn.title = ''; // skip: text always shown beneath, no cue tip
            updateTopActionLabel();
            updateSkipAdButton();
        }

        function handleSkipAd() {
            if (isAdPlaying || (state !== 'playing' && state !== 'gameover')) return;
            clearGlow();
            track('button', 'skip-level-ad-' + level, 'interact');
            playRewardedAd((success) => {
                if (!success || (state !== 'playing' && state !== 'gameover')) return;
                pokiGameplayStop();
                proceedToNextLevel();
            });
        }

        skipAdBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            if (isTouchDevice) return;
            e.stopPropagation();
            handleSkipAd();
        });
        skipAdBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
            isTouchDevice = true;
            e.stopPropagation();
            handleSkipAd();
        }, {passive: true});

        topActionBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            if (isTouchDevice) return;
            e.stopPropagation();
            handleTopAction();
        });

<script id="engine-src">
/* Chess engine: rules (0x88 board) + alpha-beta search. No dependencies. */
var ChessEngine = (function () {

  var VAL = [0, 100, 320, 330, 500, 900, 20000];

  function rnd() { seed ^= seed << 13; seed ^= seed >>> 17; seed ^= seed << 5; return seed | 0; }
  var ZP_LO = new Int32Array(16 * 128), ZP_HI = new Int32Array(16 * 128);
  for (var i = 0; i < 16 * 128; i++) { ZP_LO[i] = rnd(); ZP_HI[i] = rnd(); }

  var ZC_LO = new Int32Array(16), ZC_HI = new Int32Array(16);
  for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) { ZC_LO[i] = rnd(); ZC_HI[i] = rnd(); }
  var ZE_LO = new Int32Array(8), ZE_HI = new Int32Array(8);
  for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) { ZE_LO[i] = rnd(); ZE_HI[i] = rnd(); }

  var CASTLE_MASK = new Int8Array(128);
  for (i = 0; i < 128; i++) CASTLE_MASK[i] = 15;
  CASTLE_MASK[0] = 15 & ~2; CASTLE_MASK[4] = 15 & ~3; CASTLE_MASK[7] = 15 & ~1;
  CASTLE_MASK[112] = 15 & ~8; CASTLE_MASK[116] = 15 & ~12; CASTLE_MASK[119] = 15 & ~4;

  function sqName(s) { return 'abcdefgh'[s & 7] + ((s >> 4) + 1); }
  function sqFromName(n) { return (n.charCodeAt(1) - 49) * 16 + (n.charCodeAt(0) - 97); }
  function mFrom(m) { return m & 127; }
  function mTo(m) { return (m >> 7) & 127; }
  function mPromo(m) { return (m >> 14) & 7; }
  function mFlag(m) { return m >> 17; }
  function enc(f, t, pr, fl) { return f | (t << 7) | (pr << 14) | (fl << 17); }
